michelle balters.name: Michelle Balters
michelle balters.origin: Neurotap worked with Martin Henry Strong to find mutants for his experiments. She hates the fact that she is a mutant and worked with Strong only because he promised he would not only cure her but also help settle the severe financial burdens her parents suffered when they both were put into comas after her powers manifested. During her tenure with Strong Industries, she was romantically involved with Adam-X (X-Treme), but later betrayed him for the sake of her parents. After the initial takedown of Strong Industries, Neurotap continued to work for Strong, but felt she was in over her head and called in X-Force to assist her, allying herself with Rictor and Shatterstar in the process. ===After M-Day=== Her post-M-Day status is unknown. After the Civil War, she was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.

michelle deveraux.name: Michelle Deveraux
michelle deveraux.origin: Chief Justice Michelle Deveraux was selected as chief of a five-judge bench to trial international criminal and mutant liberator Magneto. The trial was unique and took place in Paris's Palais de Justice, with England's Attorney General James Jaspers prosecuting, Israel's Ambassador Gabrielle Haller defending and no jury. Constant terrorist attacks polarized the population. Haller's opening statement mentioned how Alpha turned Magneto into a baby, thus eliminating him and, as a consequence, effectively killing the person legally responsible for Magneto's crimes up to that point. Deveraux and the other judges deliberated on that point and agreed with it, amongst the public's booing and even threats to Deveraux. Focusing on Magneto's crimes after encountering Alpha, Jaspers called then vice commander-in-chief of the Soviet Navy Gregori Suvorov to explain how Magneto destroyed the Russian submarine Leningrad and later the city of Varykino. Eventually having the word, Magneto exposed that he felt his own survival threatened. Jaspers had a harsh remark, accusing Magneto of threatening the whole planet; Deveraux reproached Jaspers' poor manners, but Magneto answered the attorney and expanded his answer when Deveraux inquired on his goals. The trial was interrupted by terrorist organization Fenris' attack on the Palais. Magneto helped Deveraux, Haller, Sakharov and Haller's counselor Charles Xavier evacuate - Jasper rejected his offer. The party fell to the catacombs. When Fenris were eventually captured, Jaspers tried to attack helpless Fenris member Andrea Strucker with a stone, but Magneto stopped him. Jaspers accused Magneto of being as inhuman as Fenris, but Deveraux took sides for Magneto, impressed by his mercy. However, Fenris recovered and escaped, causing a flood from the Seine that took Magneto and Xavier away. Jaspers expressed his racist desire of Magneto dying, and Deveraux slapped him. Recovering in the building, Deveraux told Haller that, should Magneto have been found guilty, Deveraux would probably have accepted a sentence mitigation to avoid death penalty; but Magneto was on the loose. When Magneto was found and tried again, the bench did not include Deveraux, instead being made of Chief Justice Alexandre Gilbert Du Motier (France), Lady Janet Grace Southerland (Great Britain) and Gustave Roch Uderzo (Switzerland). This bench found that the case was beyond their -and probably anyone's- jurisdiction. Sometime later, the United Nations agreed to cede the government of the turmoiled island nation Genosha to Magneto. The United Nations called Deveraux for a committee also including Haller and then-ex-admiral Suvorov to deal with the specifics. The Committee sent Dr. Alda Huxley to the island, to counsel and watch over Magneto, but later they decided that Huxley was no longer impartial (instead being too supportive of Magneto) and they arranged to send a new advisor on mutant protocol, Scarlet Witch, member of the Avengers and daughter to Magneto. Huxley was offended at this and travelled to New York City to complain, insisting that Magneto was a reasonable ruler but the United Nations should send him more help to deal with the Genoshan crisis. The Committee declined, instead waiting for the Witch's report. While watchful, they refused to send troops, but Suvorov in particular had calculated that the Avengers would rush to rescue the Witch if Genosha fell into a civil war. While the Avengers indeed raided Genosha, they failed to stop Magneto or the situation.

michi sasaki.name: Michi Sasaki
michi sasaki.origin: Michi Sasaki, along with her husband and child, were kidnapped by the villain Doctor Demonicus. Demonicus performed genetic experiments on the family and mutated them to gain superpowers. Michi gained power to control fire and was hypnotized to believe that she was Pele, the goddess of fire. After her transformation, Michi and the mutant Sunfire were sent to attack Pearl Harbor. Following their defeat at the hands of Namor the Sub-Mariner, Hawkeye, and Spider-Woman, Pele regained her memories and was recaptured by the other Pacific Overlords. When Doctor Demonicus revealed that he had reversed the mutation of Pele's son, Kenjiro, he allowed Pele, Taifu, and Kenjiro to leave the island of Demonica in peace.

michiko musashi.name: Michiko Musashi
michiko musashi.origin: Mickey's friend, Mike Jeffries, found the Torpedo Armor in a box in his family's attic. Preferring to go in his homemade costume, he gave Mickey the suit to wear to a comic book convention. When a team of aliens focused in on the energy signature created by Mickey's suit, they attacked the convention, only to be defeated by Mickey. At first, she chose to use the suit only for quick transportation, flying across the ocean to go shop and things like that. However, when she came upon an illegal shipping operation run by Sea Urchin, she teamed up with the New Warriors to take it down. The next time Turbo was seen, Mike Jeffries was wearing the armor. Mickey would again go into action when Air Force attempted a hit on Nova and Mike, training in the Turbo armour. She did not actually use the armour, but helped turn the battle in the Warriors' favor. It quickly became apparent to Mickey, the Warriors, and eventually Mike, that she was the better Turbo. Therefore, when the new team of Warriors was formed for the Time and Time Again storyline, she was chosen to go into action. After the adventure, she was offered part time membership with the team, eventually becoming a full member when she and Alex Power were brought in by Nova to help fight the Undertow. Eventually, it was revealed that the costume was in fact the original Torpedo Armour, commissioned by the United States government, working secretly in conjunction with Volx, the Dire Wraith queen, as a suitable armour to fight Rom with. The first volume of New Warriors finished with a story in which Volx killed Mike and stole the armour from him. After the Warriors defeated Volx, Mickey offered to share joint control of the armour with Hindsight, the team's non-powered strategist. However, this would never be followed up on. Mickey would later become a central part of the team when it reformed. Firestrike (Dalton Beck), a member of Joe Silvermane's super-powered team Heavy Mettle, was hired to seduce Mickey and kill her. However, he changed his mind after falling in love with her. The team eventually found out his true identity, and he helped them put Joe behind bars, although it caused him to leave Mickey as he went into the Witness Relocation Program. After a period of absence Mickey resurfaced as the founder/organizer of Excelsior. A team of former teen heroes, Mickey, along with Phil Urich, brought together her old teammate, Darkhawk, and former teen heroes Ricochet, Lightspeed, and Chamber. Although the idea was to be a community outreach group, and not a costumed team, immediately after formation a secret benefactor hired Excelsior to hunt down and "help" a group of powered Runaways. After their experiences with the Runaways the group continued their meetings but were eventually all drawn back into heroics. Alongside the other members of the Loners, Mickey was eventually inducted into the Avengers Academy by Hawkeye after the school moved into the former headquarters of the West Coast Avengers.

michio ishimori.name: Michio Ishimori
michio ishimori.origin: Michio Ishimori, Go-Devil, was a mercenary who roamed the streets of New York City. His first encounter with superheroes was bumping into Huntara late one night during her escapades in a bar. After he brushed her off, he got into a brawl with a gang that poured beer on them, serenely beating them. He later was contacted by members of a local Asian gang when they believed that the Wakandan Vibraxas was a brute who attacked an innocent Korean store owner, when in reality saved him. They paid Go-Devil to handle him, but later when he met Vibraxas fighting alongside with the Fantastic Force and got anger when he believed they were racial attacking again. Transforming to his energy form, he attacked the Fantastic Force, gaining the upper hand, only to discover his weakness to vibrations, getting depowered and severely hurt. After listening to Vibraxas words of comfort and unity, he backed down, but a gang member the Fantastic Force were fighting didn't care for his words, only to draw a gun and be killed accidentally in self-defense by Vibraxas. After Vibraxas turned himself in and was released, his case was helped after Go-Devil talked to the police on his behalf.

michiyo watanabe.name: Michiyo Watanabe
michiyo watanabe.origin: Michiyo Watanabe was the natural daughter of a Shinto priestess who had been slain by a Yiki Onna - the Asian Snow Vampire. As an adult, she has pledged her life towards learning the ways of the samurai and combating the forces of the Yiki Onna. Accenting her martial arts prowess, Michiyo employs a samurai blade forged of solid silver as well as a gun that fires silver-nitrate dipped darts. Michiyo Watanabe was one of several specialists selected by Noah van Helsing to participate in an ambitious plot to destroy the lord of all vampires - Dracula.

fields.history: Michiyo Watanabe was the natural daughter of a Shinto priestess who had been slain by a Yiki Onna - the Asian Snow Vampire. Michiyo Watanabe was one of several specialists selected by Noah van Helsing to participate in an ambitious plot to destroy the lord of all vampires - Dracula.

mick patterson.name: Mick Patterson
mick patterson.origin: Wall was a member of Randall Shire's small traveling carnival in Australia before Shire was possessed by the alien Undying known as Semijan and subsequently enslaved Wall and his brother Key with his mutant vocal power. Wall was forced to serve as Shire's bodyguard until the mutant hero Cable stopped an assassination attempt on Shire by another Undying known as Aentaros and discredited Shire in the eyes of those he had enslaved, thus freeing them from his control. Wall and Key aided Cable in breaking into the Undying's stronghold, and fought the Undying, distracting them while Key reprogrammed the Undying's artificial intelligence program, causing them to be unable to possess anything except cockroaches for the rest of eternity. Wall was depowered after M-Day.

mickey hooper.name: Mickey Hooper
mickey hooper.origin: Mickey Hooper was a man whose violent death became an unusual source of psychic disturbance within the Citrusville swamps. Although little is known about his life, his remains were discovered long after he had been murdered with a hatchet and abandoned in the marshlands. For reasons never fully explained, the emotions surrounding Hooper's final moments lingered after death with extraordinary intensity. The overwhelming fear attached to his corpse was sensed by the Man-Thing, which recognized the presence of a profound emotional imbalance. The lingering psychic residue may also have played a role in the events surrounding Andrea Rodgers and the temporary manifestation of her fragmented personalities. Virtually nothing is known of Hooper's killer or the precise circumstances that led to his death, leaving the incident one of the many unsolved tragedies associated with the swamps surrounding the Nexus of Realities.

mickey tork.name: Mickey Tork
mickey tork.origin: Bloke was a mutant vigilante in San Francisco, where he was known by the code-name of Rainbow. There, he gained control over his skin color, but seemingly preferred pink while in action. According to X-Force intelligence, Bloke killed an average of six people per mission and had done so over two years, mainly from his own side. Part of his career included being deployed against a Balkan terrorist group. He literally pulled the head off a tank driver. He was recruited by the media-driven X-Force, and accepted, hoping to gain "fame… money… a place in history and the opportunity to put a four-hundred pound guy like me on the cultural map. And chicken would be nice." His first X-Force mission involved a trip to the South American nation of Bastrona. Their goal was to gain control of a refugee child named Paco Perez with the mutant potential to cure many diseases. The mission commander, Coach, wanted to sell Paco to The Hand. The Greenpeace forces learned of the mission and attacked. While outside, Bloke leapt to protect their informant, taking several pointless wounds. Bloke's body was burned by his teammates. The child himself was secretly sent to live with the father of Saint Anna, Bloke's teammate, who also died saving Perez.

mickey walker.name: Mickey Walker
mickey walker.origin: Mickey Walker is the younger brother of Patsy Walker. His mother Dorothy gained the family fame and notoriety through her work on the Patsy Walker comic books based on Patsy's teenage years. After their parents broke up, Mickey and Patsy moved with their mother and Dolly Donahue, their housekeeper, to Montclair, New Jersey. As an adult, Mickey moved to Oakland, California, and was visited frequently by Patsy and her then husband, Daimon Hellstrom, when they lived in San Francisco. Later, Mickey moved back to his childhood hometown in Centerville.

micky halloran.name: Micky Halloran
micky halloran.origin: Micky Halloran was the boyfriend of Katie Sawyer. He was attacked by Zeitgeist and his group The X-Cellent who were looking for Katie. But as she wasn't with Micky the group threatened him to give her up the next they were together. Katie went to Micky's place to talk to him about her recent transformation. He told her it didn't bother him but confessed that he was scared because some people attacked him as they were looking for her. All of a sudden the teens were hit with an optic blast that blew a hole through Micky's room. The X-Cellent had came back to kidnap Katie and take her back to their headquarters. Micky laid atop the rubble with a serious head injury from the blast. He called out for Katie but she couldn't help him as she was forced to teleport everyone from there leaving Micky on the ground barely conscious.

microtron.name: Microtron
microtron.origin: Princess Mari's childhood roboid tutor. Microtron could be serious, especially when Princess Mari or later his love Nanotron were in danger, but was generally something of a joker. Microtron and Nanotron sacrificed themselves so that their memories could be incorporated into a giant duplicate of the late Biotron, which would serve as the Micronauts' ship after Endeavor was destroyed. A second Microtron was later created to accompany the Micronauts on their new voyages, but it had little of the original's charm.

microtron ii.name: Microtron II
microtron ii.origin: The second Microtron Roboid was a duplicate of the original Microtron who had served with the Micronauts until his 'death'. Like his companion Biotron though, the duplicate had a completely different personality to the original and, though created to serve with them on the HMS Endeavour II, never really became a part of the team. The two Roboids horrified the crew by using technology developed in Baron Karza's Body Banks to repair injuries. They eventually returned to the ruins of Homeworld.

mictlantecuhtli.name: Mictlantecuhtli
mictlantecuhtli.origin: Mictlantecuhtli was the god of the dead of the Aztec Gods and ruled over the netherworld realm of Mictlan. As Quetzalcoatl and Tezcatlipoca destroyed each others' versions of the world in their rivalry, the bones of the previous inhabitants were sent to Mictlan. After they destroyed the Fourth Sun (the fourth world creation), Quetzalcoatl and Tezcatlipoca decided to collaborate. Quetzalcoatl accompanied his brother Xolotl to Mictlan, to steal the bones of the previous worlds' inhabitants from Mictlantecuhtli. Once safely back on Earth, they collaborated with Gaea to create a new race of mortals from the bones of the previous races.

midas.origin: ===Origins=== King Midas is born to Zeus and Cybele, a mortal woman. ===Golden Touch=== Midas was widely remembered in Ancient Greek mythology for his ability to turn everything he touched into gold. This came to be called the golden touch, or the Midas touch. King Midas found the wandering Silenus, the Satyr and companion of the god Dionysus. For his kind treatment he was rewarded by Dionysus with a wish. The king wished that all he touched might turn to gold, but when his food became gold and he nearly starved to death as a result, he realized his error. When hugged his daughter, even she turned to gold. ===20th Century=== An unnamed man summons the ghost of King Midas and demands his power to turn objects to gold. He thinks that he will be more clever than Midas and just get the power in his right hand so that he can eat with his left, but he gets in a vehicle accident and they amputate his left hand. In more recent times, an unnamed prospector in search of gold found a cave where there was a large strand of gold but when he saw that there was another man inside, he thought that someone else had preceded him in the find and then he rushed against him by not believing the story he had told him and being King Midas. This transmitted to the miner the curse of King Midas whose hands turned into gold. The miner showed his hands to the other miners he told the story to.

midget.name: Midget
midget.origin: Scintilla is a member of the Imperial Guard, a multi-ethnic group of super-powered beings who act as enforcers of the laws of the Shi'ar Empire. Under her original Guardsman name of Midget, she was among the first of the Imperial Guard encountered by the team of superhuman mutant adventurers known as the X-Men who sought to rescue the Princess-Majestrix Lilandra from her insane brother, then-Majestor D'ken. Following the orders of their emperor, the Guard clashed with the X-Men and were on the verge of winning when the band of interstellar freebooters known as the Starjammers arrived to turn the tide of battle in the X-Men's favor. Later, after the formerly exiled Deathbird had usurped the Shi'ar throne from her sister, Lilandra, Midget was amongst those Imperial Guard members who clashed with the British team Excalibur and the team of interstellar freebooters known as the Starjammers over the fate of the then-bearer of the cosmic Phoenix Force, Rachel Summers. During the war between the Shi'ar and Kree Empires, Midget - now using her new Guardsman codename of Scintilla - worked with Nightside to rescue Warstar and several Shi'ar soldiers from Avengers custody. Scintilla was one of the survivors of Vulcan's attack on the Imperial Guard. She openly questioned Gladiator's decision to take the human alive after he was finally defeated.

miek.name: Miek
miek.species: Sakaaran Native mutated by the Chaos King's energy.
miek.origin: Miek was a member of planet Sakaar's insectoid race known as "Natives". When he was young his father and most of his hive were attacked and killed by local Imperials, forcing Miek to flee underground. He was accidentally rescued, as an outcast slave, during Hulk's battle with the Red King. Soon after, the Warbound escaped with Miek secretly leading them to the place where his father was killed. The Warbound then aided him in securing his revenge. Miek and Brood, who had formed a connection due to their insect nature, freed Miek's brothers and added the Warbound to his Hive. Within a short time he underwent a metamorphosis and evolved into a giant heavily armoured "King" version of his race. Miek located one of the last Queens of his race, at an egg farm at which the Warbound were hiding. Unfortunately for Miek, and his species, the Queen was consumed by a Spike infection and had to be killed. Miek then led the Warbound in Hulk's place while Hulk, Hiroim, and Caiera attempted to obtain the allegiance of Caiera and the Shadow People. Soon, Miek discovered that loyalists to the Red King had planted a damaged warp core on the Hulk's ship, hoping it would kill the Hulk, however Miek did not tell the Hulk hoping it would encourage the Hulk to keep destroying and to "remind him" that he was not a peacekeeper but a killer. Following the explosion of the shuttle and the subsequent death of Caiera, Miek and the rest of the Warbound accompanied the Hulk back to Earth, where they pledged to aid him in a quest of vengeance against those responsible for the Hulk's forced exile. On Earth, Miek was one of the most vocal in encouraging the destruction of the planet in revenge for what was done. However, this would prove to be a mistake as Miek's treachery was exposed and it was revealed that he willingly ignored the bomb planted on the shuttle. Enraged, the Hulk and No-Name nearly killed Miek. After the Hulk's defeat Miek was captured by S.H.I.E.L.D. and placed in Wonderland and relayed information about the Warbound to help recapture them in revenge. Following the Skrull Invasion, Miek was presumably still imprisoned in the Negative Zone supervised by Wonderland's freed inmates and later overrun by Blastaar's forces. During the Chaos War, the dimensional boundaries around the Negative Zone were breached, allowing Miek and all the other bug inhabitants to spill out and enter Earth. Miek was recruited by the Chaos King to inflict as much chaos as possible. Miek pledged his loyalty toward the Chaos King as his master's goal of destroying everything the same as the Hulk's once was. Miek led an army of Prison 42 prisoners against Amadeus Cho and Galactus as they attempted to complete a gateway to the Continuum universe to save what remained of creation. Cho failed to reason with Miek as Miek refused to take anything Cho said seriously. Miek was about to kill Cho when the final battle between Hercules and the Chaos King caused an earthquake that allowed Cho to strike a distracted Miek with his Golden Mace. Miek later fled. Miek retreated to the Savage Land outpost of New Imperia after his defeat. His contact with Chaos King caused Miek to develop a hermaphroditic physiology and began laying eggs. It also caused to grow larger and stronger than before. He kept his young alive using the bodies of Sakaaran refugees. Hulk later arrived to the Savage Land after he was asked to help deal with Miek by Ka-zar. After learning of the return of the Hulk, Miek swore he would make him die by his hands. Miek captured Hulk and used his body to help feed his young. Hulk eventually regained his wits and tried killing Miek's children. He was prevented by his son Skaar who had promised to protect Miek's children. When Miek tried to make Skaar fight his father, Hulk chopped one of Miek's arms and punched him through a volcano and into a field of ice. Hulk tried to save Miek, but Miek refused to be saved by Hulk and let himself drop to his death into the ice.

might.name: Might
might.origin: Might was a member of the Freelancers, a group of super-powered enforcers who were hired by Roxxon to shut down the protesters at the Angeles National Forest that opposed the company's intention to build a pipeline that connected their West Coast headquarters to a new deepwater drilling platform off the coast. When the Champions arrived to the scene to stop them, Might directed her teammates, and when both teams clashed, she confronted Ms. Marvel and Viv. Their battle was interrupted by the arrival of a monster that originated from the Leviathon Tide that was in the process of invading the Earth. Cyclops convinced Might and Crush, the only two remaining Freelancers standing up, to help them fight the creature. After the Champions and Crush weakened the monster, Hulk performed a Fastball Special with Might, destroying the monster's head. Once that monster and another which followed it were defeated, the Freelancers remained behind lamenting the destruction of the drilling platform by the landing of a third monster, which would potentially cost them their paycheck. The Freelancers were later hired for other jobs, including disrupting a wage protest in Durham, North Carolina and displacing homeless people from a tent city in Los Angeles, California. The Freelancers invited two of the homeless people they displaced to their compound, and manipulated them into fighting each other, later using Panic's powers to have them tell the authorities that the Champions had assaulted them.

mighty mother ii.name: Mighty Mother II
mighty mother ii.origin: Following the death of the previous generation of the familiar Filipino superhero group the Triumph Division at the hands of suicide bombers during a ceremony in Plaza de Roma, the next member in each of the deceased members' bloodlines succeeded them, following the team's centuries-old tradition. This included the appointment of a new Mighty Mother. The members of the fledgling generation were visited at the Triumph Hall by Iron Man to pay his respects. They were nervous and eager, but also hopeful, which reminded Iron Man of the early days of the Avengers. When Tony Stark became a prisoner of the Mandarin, his allies Pepper Potts and Bethany Cabe set up a meeting in international waters with the Triumph Division and the Chinese superhero team the Dynasty and requested their aid to take part in a rogue rescue operation to retrieve Stark from Mandarin City. Both teams were glad to help since Tony Stark had been present for them. The heroes arrived during the final battle between Iron Man and the Mandarin. While the Dynasty took down the Mandarin's armed forces, the Triumph Division engaged the Titanomechs until Iron Man used the Swarm to destroy them. Some time later, the Triumph Division prevented the Macronaut from making a landfall in Quezon City. After the defeat of Sindr, the Queen of Cinders, Mighty Mother was with the other members of her team and Aero in Shanghai as they were being celebrated for their bravery for defending the Philippines and the rest of Southeast Asia. Also when Wave talked about her past with Aero, Mighty Mother was one of the many heroes that showed up to help Pearl after she her gained her hydrokinetic abilities.

mighty oak.name: Mighty Oak
mighty oak.origin: The Mighty Oak was an oak tree that was the target of an atomic test, which mutated it, giving it self-awareness, telepathy, and the ability to move by lifting its roots. It took it upon itself to spread its acorns across the world in order to grow an army of oak trees with similar powers, and then centuries in the future, overthrow humanity and govern Earth 'without greed, without jealousy, without violence'. Unknown to the oak tree, this was the very reason it had been targeted by the atomic test, as the scientists who oversaw the test also believed oak trees would be better stewards of the Earth than violent humans. Mighty Oak later turned up alive decades later in Monster Metropolis shortly before the Hunter of Monster Special Force raided the city; it was seen with similar plant monster, the Thing that Crawled by Night.

miguel alfredo navatilas.name: Miguel Alfredo Navatilas
miguel alfredo navatilas.origin: Born in South American crime-prone country Medisuela, Miguel Alfredo Navatilas was a right-wing officer in the Medisuelan National Defense Force, reaching the rank of General. The United States of America supported Navatilas when he carried out a military coup and took power in the country, after which the United States government kept its affinity with the Navatilas regime, especially when Medisuela had a democratic election and Navatilas consolidated his position. As the president of Medisuela, he kept his official residence in the country's Presidential Palace, in the capital city, Medisuela City; he kept his personal weapon collection in one of the rooms of the Palace. However, soon Navatilas fell out of favor due to his coercive tactics and accusations of drug trafficking, electoral fraud and human right abuses. This was enough for the President of the United States to criticize Navatilas, leading to a climate of tension between their countries. Navatilas had also been accused of addiction, alcoholism, child abuse, communism, deviation, murder, smuggling, theft, torture, rape and satanism, leading to a moment when he showed his scalp on TV for interviewers to look for the . Navatilas was a subject of media attention both in TV program A Current Affair and by , the latter of which called him "The Name That Strikes Instant Terror." Undeterred, Navatilas enjoyed his reputation as a dangerous man, both for the attention it gave him and because it gave his enemies a high opinion of Navatilas. International law enforcement agency S.H.I.E.L.D. however perceived Navatilas as a two-bit dictator. Corrupt U.S. Attorney General Roger Mollech, who presented a public image of aggressivity against narcotics smuggling into the U.S., secretly made an alliance with Navatilas: For decades, Medisuela had become increasingly involved in illegal narcotics production and trafficking. Law enforcement agencies in the United States seized these illegal drugs, but Mollech used his influence in the United States Department of Justice to control these, re-selling them in the streets to obtain untraceable funds, then used this money to order weapons that he secretly sold to Navatilas as part of the so-called Project: Democracy. Navatilas was supposed to use these weapons against neighboring countries Argentina and Paraguay to overthrow or intimidate their governments through coups, insurrections or armed conflicts, so as to ensure changes in their policies according to Mollech's interests. Secretly, however, Mollech was providing Navatilas with defective weapons that exploded after just a few uses, killing the operator. This was because Mollech's real plan was to pressure the United States government to invade Medisuela, then depose Navatilas and replace him with a puppet government whose strings would be pulled by Mollech himself. To that end, Mollech used his position to damage Navatilas' already weak international public image. Mollech told Navatilas that he was spending money to improve Navatilas' reputation while ensuring deniability, but Mollech really gave an image as a strong attorney pursuing criminals due to the , and putting Navatilas himself in his sights, his anti-Navatilas position being even stronger than the White House's. Still, Mollech sent his aide Angela Stone to meet with Navatilas in the Presidential Palace, report progress and give him a suitcase with money; Navatilas eagerly opened it, only too late considering that it may had been bobby-trapped by his enemies. Navatilas also tried to impress Stone with his reputation as a monster and flirt with her, failing at both attempts. The increase in weapons trafficking due to Project: Democracy attracted the attention of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms. Fearing that it was related to the creation of a terrorist group, they asked Captain America to investigate. Captain America find a weapon delivery from one of Mollech's distributors, Doctor Slickster, to two Medisuelan agents of Navatila's, in American soil. The Medisuelans were promised a smooth operation, as Mollech had sent his own (rogue) team in the military, the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA), to keep other law agencies away - but Captain America attacked the warehouse. The Medisuelans were killed in the explosion of a sabotaged weapon, then the DIA revealed their presence, pretending to be on the same side Captain America was, and offered to "clean up" the crime scene and arrest the criminal, while also telling Captain America that the shipment was intended for Medisuela, not for a terrorist group. Captain America decided to continue his investigation, thou, finding out that the DIA had "signed out" the shipment of sabotaged weapons and flew it to Medisuela themselves. Simultaneously, the drug sales also attracted the attention of vigilante the Punisher, who also decided to investigate them further. miguel diasturian.name: Miguel DiAsturian
miguel diasturian.origin: Miguel DiAsturian was a renowned Spanish swordsmith whose weapons were prized for their exceptional craftsmanship and for the meticulous records he kept regarding each blade's creation and ownership. Though celebrated as an artisan during his lifetime, DiAsturian was also rumored to possess knowledge of the occult, a reputation that eventually brought him into conflict with the authorities of his era. Centuries after one of his blades came into the possession of Captain Fate, the weapon resurfaced when it was discovered embedded in the body of the captain of Southlands Airways Flight 904 following the aircraft's destruction over Florida. Barbara Bannister immediately recognized the sword as an authentic DiAsturian creation and believed that tracing its history might reveal the identity of its owner and the mystery behind the attack on the airliner. Through painstaking research, Bannister uncovered records linking the weapon to the legendary and feared Magus Sword, the cursed blade wielded by Captain Fate. During her investigation she also discovered that, the swordsmith's name was erroneously recorded as Ferdinand DiAusterian, although the blade's true creator was Miguel DiAsturian. Historical accounts revealed that DiAsturian had been more than a master swordmaker. He was reputedly a sorcerer whose mystical practices attracted the attention of the Inquisition. Arrested and condemned for witchcraft, DiAsturian was burned at the stake. According to legend, his enchanted weapons were destroyed alongside him to prevent their supernatural powers from surviving their maker. However, Bannister's research suggested that not all of DiAsturian's creations had perished in the purge. A small number of blades apparently survived the destruction. Among these surviving relics was the Magus Sword, a weapon imbued with powerful mystical properties and destined to become the signature blade of Captain Fate.

miguel legar.name: Miguel Legar
miguel legar.origin: ===Early Life=== Miguel's early life was shrouded in mysticism and magical pursuits. As a talented mage, he honed his skills in the arcane arts from a young age, delving deep into the intricate world of magic. His innate abilities and dedication to the mystical arts distinguished him as a promising talent within the realm of sorcery. His exceptional mastery of magic led to his recruitment by the enigmatic Spider Society, an ancient group dedicated to safeguarding the Spider-Totems and maintaining the delicate balance within the mystic realms. He embarked on regular missions, venturing into various corners of Earth to identify and recruit individuals displaying latent potential or a strong connection to the Spider-Totems. His discerning eye for identifying those worthy of harnessing the spider-like abilities crucial for the Society's cause made him a valuable asset. Amidst his tasks, Legar remained committed to upholding the Society's principles, seeking out individuals with the innate qualities needed to become defenders of the Spider-Totems. ===Araña=== Miguel followed a lead on a "new initiate" to the Santa Monica Pier in LA. He was attacked by an armed gunman; but Miguel had anticipated the attacker stopping the bullet in mid air with a wave of his hand, before covering the distance with a bounding leap and commanding his attacker to sleep. The next day on Anya's first day of school she found herself entangled in a conflict between the Spider Society and the Sisterhood of the Wasp. Severely injured during the skirmish, Anya faced a mortal threat until Legar intervened. In a ritualistic act, Legar bestowed upon her a spider-shaped tattoo that granted her spider-like abilities, effectively making her a member of the Spider Society's cadre of Hunters. Legar's mentorship and initiation of Anya into the Society marked a significant turning point in her life, leading her to embrace her new superhero identity as Araña. Legar, alongside WebCorps operatives Nina Smith and Ted Mankowski, provided guidance and support to Anya as she embarked on her heroic journey. ===Araña's Mentor=== 250px|left|thumb|Webcorp Miguel Legar continued to mentor and assist Anya as she encountered various challenges. Anya discovered the recruitment of a teenager named Amun by the Sisterhood of the Wasp. This revelation, coupled with confrontations and threats posed by Amun, led to moments of doubt for Anya regarding her duty as a Hunter and the risks it posed to her loved ones. Notably, an encounter with the iconic hero Spider-Man reinforced the importance of responsibility in wielding her newfound powers. Legar intervened to prevent Anya from recklessly pursuing personal vendettas against antagonists like Jaime Jade, a criminal with ties to the death of Anya's mother. Legar's guidance and support were instrumental in helping Anya navigate moral dilemmas and confrontations with adversaries. ===Death=== Anya discovered that her exoskeleton and Hunter abilities were not inherent traits but granted artificially. Realizing her true identity and renouncing her ties to WebCorps, Anya relinquished her Hunter abilities to Nina, paving the way for a new chapter in her life. miguel legar.bio: ===Early Life=== Miguel's early life was shrouded in mysticism and magical pursuits. As a talented mage, he honed his skills in the arcane arts from a young age, delving deep into the intricate world of magic. His innate abilities and dedication to the mystical arts distinguished him as a promising talent within the realm of sorcery. His exceptional mastery of magic led to his recruitment by the enigmatic Spider Society, an ancient group dedicated to safeguarding the Spider-Totems and maintaining the delicate balance within the mystic realms. He embarked on regular missions, venturing into various corners of Earth to identify and recruit individuals displaying latent potential or a strong connection to the Spider-Totems. His discerning eye for identifying those worthy of harnessing the spider-like abilities crucial for the Society's cause made him a valuable asset. Amidst his tasks, Legar remained committed to upholding the Society's principles, seeking out individuals with the innate qualities needed to become defenders of the Spider-Totems. ===Araña=== Miguel followed a lead on a "new initiate" to the Santa Monica Pier in LA. He was attacked by an armed gunman; but Miguel had anticipated the attacker stopping the bullet in mid air with a wave of his hand, before covering the distance with a bounding leap and commanding his attacker to sleep. The next day on Anya's first day of school she found herself entangled in a conflict between the Spider Society and the Sisterhood of the Wasp. Severely injured during the skirmish, Anya faced a mortal threat until Legar intervened. In a ritualistic act, Legar bestowed upon her a spider-shaped tattoo that granted her spider-like abilities, effectively making her a member of the Spider Society's cadre of Hunters. Legar's mentorship and initiation of Anya into the Society marked a significant turning point in her life, leading her to embrace her new superhero identity as Araña. Legar, alongside WebCorps operatives Nina Smith and Ted Mankowski, provided guidance and support to Anya as she embarked on her heroic journey. ===Araña's Mentor=== 250px|left|thumb|Webcorp Miguel Legar continued to mentor and assist Anya as she encountered various challenges. Anya discovered the recruitment of a teenager named Amun by the Sisterhood of the Wasp. This revelation, coupled with confrontations and threats posed by Amun, led to moments of doubt for Anya regarding her duty as a Hunter and the risks it posed to her loved ones. Notably, an encounter with the iconic hero Spider-Man reinforced the importance of responsibility in wielding her newfound powers. Legar intervened to prevent Anya from recklessly pursuing personal vendettas against antagonists like Jaime Jade, a criminal with ties to the death of Anya's mother. Legar's guidance and support were instrumental in helping Anya navigate moral dilemmas and confrontations with adversaries. ===Death=== Anya discovered that her exoskeleton and Hunter abilities were not inherent traits but granted artificially. Realizing her true identity and renouncing her ties to WebCorps, Anya relinquished her Hunter abilities to Nina, paving the way for a new chapter in her life. miguel lopez iruli.name: Miguel Lopez-Iruli
miguel lopez iruli.origin: In Washington, D.C., government officials learn that relief supplies headed to war ravaged Europe are being stolen when they arrive at the shipping destination in Algiers. In order to put a stop to it, the government gets the aid of Captain America and Bucky and send them to Algiers to investigate. Captain America agrees to take the case, but insists that their involvement be publicised. When the two heroes arrive in Algiers there is a welcoming committee waiting for them led by Miguel Juan Gonzales Lopez-Iruli, a local hotel owner who is obsessed with American culture and legally changed his name to "Mike Reilly". As soon as they arrive, Cap and Bucky are attacked by assassins whom they easily round up and turn over to the police. Mike then takes them to his hotel where he gives them a room to stay in for the duration of their stay. As they head to their room, they spot a veiled woman leaving their room, and race after her but she manages to give them the slip. Entering their shabby room, they find a note from the woman -- named Sari -- warning them to trust nobody and that they will talk soon. They are soon visited by a man named Pepe who offers to sell them information for ten thousand Francs. He tells them to meet him later at the Cafe Des Femmes before disappearing just as Reilly arrives to give them dinner. As the two heroes eat, a member of the hotel staff bursts in to tell them all that he assassins who were captured earlier managed to escape, angering Mike Reilly. Mike apologizes, telling them the authorities in the area are not trust worthy. Left alone again, Cap and Bucky are convinced that they can't trust anyone. They then sneak out of the hotel to search for the assassins and clues to who is stealing the supplies that are due to arrive. They first pay a visit to the loading docks where the supplies are transferred to truck. Getting cover in a covered truck, they go along with the shipment when suddenly it's attacked by a car full of assassins. Cap and Bucky force them to flee and chase them off to the Casba, a bar where the local criminal element hangs out. They are attacked by the patrons for violating the lack of law enforcement but are rescued by Sari who leads them away through a secret tunnel. Led back to the hotel, Sari leaves again, leaving Cap and Bucky back at square one. They then decide that they should take up Pepe's offer and go to see Mike Reilly to see if they can borrow the money to him. Reilly is hurt that they did not come to him for information but agrees to lend them the money to pay Pepe's information fee. When the heroes go to rendezvous with the informant they arrive just in time to see him get gunned down. Captain America and Bucky jump the assassins, who they unmask and reveal to be American gangsters. Knowing who is behind the entire operation, Cap takes Bucky back to the hotel where he confronts Mike Reilly. Reilly and his men try to eliminate Captain America and Bucky and easily rounds them up for the authorities.

miguel provenza.name: Miguel Provenza
miguel provenza.origin: El Conquistador was a mutant who used his abilities to establish himself as crimelord for which he enjoyed his lifestyle from a mansion in Madrid. He tried to extort the town of San Elainya, but one of its residents, Migdalia, contacted El Águila. El Águila travelled to the village and defeated several of el Conquistador's henchmen which drew their boss back to the village. El Águila was initially caught off guard due to no knowledge that the Conquistador had any superhuman abilities. El Águila recovered and defeated him by severing his link with the Earth, returning him to true form. He was later de-powered after M-Day.

miguel rico.name: Miguel Rico
miguel rico.origin: Miguel Rico was a con-man, blackmailer, and sold information for the right price. By the winter of 1943, he was selling the details of American shipping roots to Nazi spy Baroness von Kampf, as well as blackmailing rich socialite Grace Dana to keep forged letters that would shame her and her husband James in the eyes of the public and ruin her husband's career. When the press began suspecting that Baroness von Kampf was more than a refugee from her home country, her leader Bruno Beitz ordered her to eliminate Rico before he could blow her cover. At the same time, Grace Dana confided in her friend, socialite Marla Drake who was secretly the costumed crime fighter Miss Fury. Marla agreed to lend Grace the most recent money demand on the condition that she get introduced to Rico. Rico was charmed by Marla's beauty and she convinced him to go on a date with her. Before his date with Marla, von Kampf came for a visit demanding that he give her the information he has been paying him for. He then scoffed at her and told the Baroness to leave. The Baroness instead pretended to storm out but hide out in Rico's home until Rico had left. Marla was planning on standing Rico up in order to break into his apartment as Miss Fury and recover the blackmail letters from his safe. Noticing that the lights to his apartment were turned back on Rico rushed back up to his apartment and caught Miss Fury poking into his wall safe. Pulling a gun out he attempted to shoot the heroine but missed. While in the shadows the Baroness fired her own gun wounding Rico. The Baroness then dialed the operator and left the phone off the hook and then fled the scene leaving Miss Fury to take the wrap for what she hoped was Rico's murder. When the police arrived at the scene, Miss Fury fled and Miguel Rico was taken to the hospital where he was expected to recover. When Detective Carey came to question him, Rico refused to talk and after the detective had left decided to leave the hospital despite warning that he wasn't fully healed. Wanting revenge against the Baroness, Rico climbed onto the balcony of her penthouse apartment where he was attacked by the recently installed guard dogs. Rico managed to shoot one of them dead and fight off the other. When the Baroness came home, Miguel attacked her, blacking one of her eyes and taking the expensive necklace around her neck for re-compensation for the time he lost in the hospital. thumb|174px|Posing as Miss Fury During this time, Rico also discovered the Miss Fury costume hidden in a potted plant by Marla Drake earlier and decides to pose as Miss Fury for his next job. Hired by a spy to steal a supply of Acrothorium, an element invented by elderly scientist Jan Novak that can destroy all metals. Wearing the Miss Fury costume, he smothered Novak with a pillow and opened up the secret compartment where his notes and the Acrothorium supply was hidden and found it missing. Suspecting Novak's nurse he and his employer began following her. The nurse sought refuge in Marla Drake's home, who was already wondering who was posing as her. Deciding to lead her impostor into a trap, she posed as the nurse with a new costume underneath in the hopes of leading the false Miss Fury into a trap. When her impostor attacked, Marla changed into her costume which led to a fight that took them to the cities roof tops and attracted the attention of the police including Detective Dan Carey. During the fight, the real Miss Fury triumphed by knocking her impostor off a building and getting him caught up in a bundle of clothing, making his arrest an easy one. Unmasked, Rico denied any involvement in the death of Novak and was taken into police custody. There he explained that he was framed by Miss Fury, whom he believed was Baroness von Kampf, but was informed that the Baroness had fled to South America prior to Novak's death. When Carey began demanding answers from Rico about his accomplice, Rico was shot dead by said accomplice who fired his gun through a window, before he could talk.

miguel rodriguez.name: Miguel Rodriguez
miguel rodriguez.first_appearance: Fantastic Four in ¡Ataque del M.O.D.O.K.! Vol 1 1
miguel rodriguez.origin: Son of Puerto Rican , Miguel Rodriguez went against his parents wishes and enlisted in the U.S. Army after 9/11. While in Iraq, Rodriguez's squad was hit by an I.E.D., resulting in the death of everyone except Rodriguez and his Sergeant. When a series of R.P.G.'s came down, Rodriguez panicked and ran, leaving his Sergeant to die as well. After returning to Puerto Rico, Rodriguez turned to alcohol in order to deal with his guilt and PTSD until one night a mysterious figure visited him offering redemption. The figure revealed that he was the latest in a line a protectors of Puerto Rico and the he has chosen Rodriguez to be his successor. The figure bestowed his powers upon Rodriguez and he became El Vejigante, protector of Puerto Rico, vowing to be a better hero than he was a soldier. As a new hero, Rodriguez later teamed up with Mister Fantastic and Invisible Woman of the Fantastic Four, who had been on vacation in Puerto Rico, in order to stop a series of scientific heists committed by M.O.D.O.K. and his A.I.Monkeys.

miguel santos.name: Miguel Santos
miguel santos.origin: ===Early Life=== Miguel Santos was the eldest child of Mexican immigrants living in in East Los Angeles, California, the son of Maria Santos and Carlos Santos. He grew up alongside his older brother José and younger sister Lisa. The family faced tragedy early on when Carlos, was killed under controversial circumstances tied to his involvement with a radical scientific faction known as the Legion of Living Lightning. The Legion, a group of rogue scientists and soldiers, believed in using advanced technology to overthrow world governments. In a catastrophic clash with the Hulk, their experimental Lightning Machine went out of control, killing most of the group including Carlos. In the years that followed, Miguel and his siblings grew up surrounded by escalating gang violence, with rival groups such as the Jaguars and the Snakes primarily composed of Mexican and Vietnamese youth vying for territorial control. Determined to stay out of gang life, Miguel became a protective influence on his younger brother, José. Despite his father's fate, Miguel began to romanticise the Legion's vision, believing their motives had merit even if their methods did not. His closest confidante was his girlfriend, Asuka. ===Becoming Living Lightning=== Miguel's turning point came when he encountered a mortally wounded survivor of the original Legion, who relayed the organisation’s true ideals before succumbing to his injuries. Driven by a need to understand his father's cause, Miguel decrypted the Legion's hidden files and traced the site of their obliterated base. Within the ruins, he discovered remnants of their advanced technology, including a fingerprint-recognition glove that granted him access to the inner sanctum. Once inside, Miguel unintentionally activated the Legion’s "Lightning Machine," triggering an explosion that bathed him in unknown energy. Rather than killing him, the blast transformed Miguel into a being of living electricity. As he flew over Fullerton testing his powers, the energy he released caused a citywide blackout, drawing the attention of Jim Hammond, the original Human Torch, now a member of the West Coast Avengers. Miguel instigated a skirmish, enthralled by his new abilities, which escalated when Doctor Pym and the Wasp joined the fray. Pym tricked him into grounding through a tether linked to the Avengers' Rover aircraft, triggering an energy surge that appeared to vaporize Miguel on impact. In reality, Miguel’s body had disintegrated into dispersed electroplasmic particles. These were detected and recovered by Doctor Demonicus, who used his equipment to reconstitute Miguel into human form. Demonicus offered him a place among the Pacific Overlords, his cadre of enhanced operatives. Believing he was a fugitive with no other recourse, Miguel accepted. Demonicus outfitted him with a stabilising suit that allowed him to toggle between human and energy states—but retained override control, ensuring Miguel's obedience under threat of death. The West Coast Avengers soon clashed with the Pacific Overlords, who had captured several members and transported them to Demonicus' undersea base. Demonicus sought to establish a new nation, Demonica, over which he would reign as supreme leader. During a failed escape attempt, the mind-controlled Scarlet Witch and the Overlord Pele broke free, only to be savagely attacked. Disillusioned by the Overlords' cruelty, Miguel refused to participate in their execution and was reassigned to guard duty. As Demonica rose from the ocean floor, the Avengers mounted a full-scale assault. Miguel initially defended the Overlords but switched sides after Demonicus threatened the Scarlet Witch. Destroying the control circuitry in his suit, Miguel enabled Wanda to regain control and turn the tide of battle. Fighting alongside the Avengers, Miguel helped defeat the monstrous Kain, solidifying his status as a true hero. With several Avengers stepping down from active duty, the Wasp nominated Miguel as her replacement. He accepted, officially becoming a member of the West Coast Avengers. Following his induction into the West Coast Avengers, Miguel returned to East Los Angeles to reconnect with his family and explain his transformation into the Living Lightning. However, he found that much had changed during his absence. His younger brother, José, had joined the Jaguars, a local gang, which resulted in a violent drive-by shooting at their home. The attack, carried out by the rival Vietnamese gang known as the Snakes, tragically claimed the life of Miguel's younger sister, Lisa. Miguel learned that his former girlfriend, Asuka, had moved on and was now involved with Song, the leader of the Snakes. When a confrontation erupted between the gangs at a local school, Miguel intervened and attempted to defuse the violence. Song opened fire during the standoff, injuring a Jaguar named Carlos. Miguel managed to prevent further bloodshed, but Carlos recovered and killed Song in retaliation. Miguel talk

miguel stone.name: Miguel Stone
miguel stone.origin: Miguel Stone is the son of Tyler Stone and Conchata O'Hara. Similar to his Earth-928 counterpart, Miguel underwent an experiment that mixed his DNA with that of a spider's. He would succeed his father as the Baron of 2099, CEO of Alchemax, and leader of the Avengers. ===Defenders=== After an attempt on Roberta Mendez's life, Stone sent the Avengers to investigate Martin Hargood, who he believed to have hired the assassin. When the Avengers came back, they brought with them the vigilante group known as the Defenders. Miguel offered them a place at Alchemax, but they declined. Since it was illegal to be a superhero team independent of Alchemax and declared them criminals. During the team's escape, Miguel's father unexpectedly arrived for a visit. Tyler would demand more say in the direction of Alchemax. Meanwhile, Hargood would summon the Dweller-in-Darkness. Miguel called the Defenders, allowing them to intervene without being arrested. While the heroes dealt with the eminent danger, he took his father to the safe room. On the way there, Tyler revealed that he was the one who ordered the assassination of Captain America causing Miguel to murder his father out of vengeance. After the danger was averted, Miguel retracted his order of declaring the Defenders as outlaws.

mikas.name: Mikas
mikas.origin: Mikas was an android construct, used by 'Mr.Kline', himself an android sent from the distant future by a super-computer to avert that very future from ever occurring. As part of this, Mikas was deployed to destroy Iron Man through mental manipulation of Marianne Rogers, his then-girlfriend. This plan, which involved deception after deception, ultimately failed and while Iron Man and Rogers escaped with their lives, Mikas was crushed under falling debris and destroyed. Mikas was not aware that he was an android, believing instead he was a near-godlike mutant whose powers came from the Earth itself, specifically geothermal processes.

mike carlino.name: Mike Carlino
mike carlino.origin: Mike “The Monster” Carlino was a Brooklyn crime boss and one of the targets Deadpool was hired to eliminate by Fred Pierson. Deadpool later learned from Ananastasia that both Big Eddie B., another crime boss on the list, and Mike “The Monster” Carlino, would be present at a nightclub in Sheepshead Bay, allowing Deadpool to eliminate both in a single operation. Using his image inducer, Deadpool assumed Carlino’s appearance and confronted Big Eddie B., falsely claiming that he had slept with Eddie’s wife and was now pursuing his daughter, Misty. Deadpool then entered the room where Carlino was gambling at a roulette table and provoked him as well. The deception escalated into a gunfight between the two crime bosses and their respective associates, resulting in the deaths of both men.

mike dolan.name: Mike Dolan
mike dolan.origin: Mike Dolan was an ambulance racketeer that was in operation during the 1940's. He attempted to influence hospitals to purchase his ambulances and used hard tactics to punish those who refused. His criminal activities came to an end the day when he attempted to pressure Hillcrest Hospital into purchasing some of his ambulances. Doctor Norton, the superintendent of the hospital, refused to purchase ambulances from Dolan. Angered by this rejection, Dolan lit the hospital on fire and left the patients and staff to burn to death. His mistake was doing this as the hero known only as Jack Frost was passing by. Frost put the fire out and saved the people trapped inside before pursuing after Dolan. Dolan returned to his headquarters, and when Jack Frost arrived and attempted to confront him, Dolan tried to shoot the hero. He had his gun frozen to his hand for his troubles and fled the scene as the authorities came to apprehend Jack Frost, who they erroneously accused of starting the hospital fire. Dolan escaped in his car, but Jack Frost followed the speeding vehicle through a winding mountain road. Frost downed a tree to stop Dolan from fleeing, causing a fatal automobile crash.

mike fallon.name: Mike Fallon
mike fallon.origin: Mike Fallon was an escaped convict who heard news about how some scientists wanted someone to test the Metallo Armor which was built to withstand radiation. In order to be safe from the police, Mike Fallon tested the armor and found himself safe from the police in it. Mike Fallon then took the Metallo Armor on a crime spree and plans to recruit some prisoners to be his personal army. During his time in the Metallo armor, Mike Fallon started to feel different pains. The scientists said that the only treatment for them was radiation. As getting treated for the pains would result in him being apprehended by the police, Mike Fallon piloted the Metallo Armor into the desert in order to think it over. The Metallo Armor later appeared amongst the monsters that cause havoc on Earth.

mike mullins.name: Mike Mullins
mike mullins.origin: Mike Mullins was an aspiring ventriloquist who struggled to find success in the entertainment world. Despite visiting numerous booking agencies, he repeatedly failed to secure employment, yet remained convinced that his vocal talents would eventually make him wealthy without needing conventional work. While reading a newspaper in a city park, Mullins noticed an article about a strange gorilla recently captured by police and placed in a zoo. Inspired by the publicity surrounding the creature, he devised a scheme to attract attention to himself. Visiting the zoo, Mullins used his ventriloquism skills to project a voice toward the animal’s enclosure, creating the illusion that the gorilla could speak. Through the performance, he made the creature claim it was an extraterrestrial visitor stranded on Earth. The stunt had unexpected consequences. Zoo officials, believing the being to be intelligent, released it from captivity. The creature immediately seized Mullins and led him away into nearby woods while onlookers, convinced the alien was harmless, refused to intervene. Away from the crowd, Mullins discovered the truth: the being genuinely was an alien explorer who had landed on Earth for repairs but had been captured before learning human languages. Having listened to Mullins’ performance, the alien quickly learned English and revealed its spacecraft. Grateful for inadvertently helping it communicate, the extraterrestrial decided to reward Mullins by taking him along on a return journey to its homeworld as a companion during the long voyage. As the ship departed Earth, Mullins realized that his greatest performance had succeeded too well—leaving him unwillingly carried into space.

mike swift.name: Mike Swift
mike swift.first_appearance: Captain America and the Mighty Avengers Vol 1 2
mike swift.origin: Mike Swift was one of the members of Blue Streak's newest team, the Fast Five, as Gold Rush. Soon after robbing a bank, the team skated through the city, but soon came across Spectrum of the Mighty Avengers, they divided to avoid capture, but the other Avengers followed their trail. Gold Rush stuck with Blue Streak, but surrendered to Power Man after White Tiger easily tore apart Blue Streak's suit. Gold Rush and the rest of the Fast Five appeared as inmates at Pleasant Hill. The Fast Five attempted to steal Asgardian weapons that were brought to Earth after the War of the Realms, but the new Valkyrie appeared to prevent them from taking Dragonfang, the sword of Brunnhilde, the previous Valkyrie. As Valkyrie dealt with the rest of the Fast Five, Gold Rush attempted to run away with Dragonfang in tow, however, he was tripped up by Bullseye, who took the sword and killed Gold Rush with it.

The Fast Five attempted to steal Asgardian weapons that were brought to Earth after the War of the Realms, but the new Valkyrie appeared to prevent them from taking Dragonfang, the sword of Brunnhilde, the previous Valkyrie. As Valkyrie dealt with the rest of the Fast Five, Gold Rush attempted to run away with Dragonfang in tow, however, he was tripped up by Bullseye, who took the sword and killed Gold Rush with it.
fields.notes: It's currently unknown if this character has any relation to Jonathan Swift (Blue Streak), the leader of Fast Five.

mike the strong man.name: Mike the Strong Man
mike the strong man.origin: Mike was a strong man hired by the Circus of Crime at a time when their usual strong man Bruno was absent, presumably imprisoned for past criminal acts by the gang. As a publicity gimmick, Mike impersonated the super-hero Thor as part of his circus act. He unknowingly met Thor, in his then-mortal guise as Dr. Donald Blake, when Mike suffered a severe back sprain in the middle of his act, consequences of the theft of an oversized government computer setup performed earlier. Volunteering his time, Blake gave Mike a powerful sedative which quickly knocked him out, leaving the strong man sleeping while Blake, in his Asgardian identity, confronted his colleagues over the computer theft. He was presumably taken into custody by the police afterwards, but he has not been seen since then.

mike trapp.name: Mike Trapp
mike trapp.origin: Detective Mike Trapp was a police detective who was active in the 1940s. He was most commonly known for his ability to deduce and solve the mysteries. In his first recorded appearance Detective Trapp investigates the murder of Mrs. Thornton at the Parks Arms apartment, deducing that the janitor had done the crime after Mrs. Thornton caught him trying to steal a diamond from her. He then began working with beat cop Officer Ryan on a number of cases, such as when he deduced that Jeff Wolfgang had murdered his uncle, solved the murder of Anti-Nazi author Richard Ranes, determined that disgruntled employee Mr. Casey was responsible for robbing the Smith Warehouse Office, that Peter Van Stone had kidnapped his own uncle in order to collect ransom money to pay his debts, that a hotel bellhop murdered millionaire playboy Henry Richard, apprehend Charley Dine, and lastly apprehending gambler Lucky Adams. Shortly after the Lucky Adams case, Mike Trapp ceased working with Officer Ryan and began working with crime scene photographer Pepper Burns. On their first case they exposed Miss Walton, secretary of the wealthy Cyrus Crane as her employers killer, and both capture Pettibone, a butler who tries to get away with stealing his employer Mrs. Van Aster's diamond masquerade mask. The pair also helped expose Mr. Reins as the killer responsible for the murder of actress Brenda Kane after she attempted to blackmail him. Mike Trapp and Pepper Burns next exposed a Nazi killer who was hired to kill Jeff Hartley who was supposed to testify sedition trial. Later, the duo went to the movies and discover that Detective Peter Haggerty has been murdered. Learning that he was hunting down criminal Lars Logan, Trapp exposes Logan posing as one of the theater ushers and arrests him. Mike and Pepper then investigated the disappearance of Jim Cobb. Finding Cobb's gold tooth in the ashen driveway of his home, Trapp arrests his wife, who he explains burned her husbands bodies and dumped the ashes on the driveway. On their next case, Trapp and Burns investigated the murder of the foreign correspondent for the New York Daily News and reveal that the killer is his jealous co-worker Scott who wished to obtain the job. Mike Trapp and Pepper Burns investigate a check forgery at a local business firm. Trapp deduces that the man responsible is an elderly employee. They also investigated a country murder of a local hermit and determine that an area farmer was responsible. After they investigated the apparent suicide of wife of writer Pen Potter, and determine that the writer was responsible for murdering her. Mike and Pepper then exposed bank William Grayson as the Clutching Claw, a killer who is has been murdering his colleagues who stood to inherit a portion of a vast fortune. Mike Trapp and Pepper Burns then solved the theft of missing Radium from a hospital, exposing Dr. Keller as the thief when they reveal he was in possession of it by turning off the lights. During his next case, Trapp investigated the murder of a night club owner and ex-con named Lacey. He managed to catch Earl Sachette, proving he was the killer due to the fact that Sachette had claimed he was in Cuba at the time of the murder and presented a passport with Cuban immigration stamps, during a period which American citizens did not require to have their passports stamped. Next Mike and Pepper Burns, Mike managed to nab caught the killers of "Big Chips" Malone. Soon after, Mike was called to the scene of a suspicious death of wealthy Aunt Christy, whose surviving relatives inform him that she died naturally some time earlier. However, Trapp, noticing they tried to make the time of death seem longer by plucking off petals from the table side Gardania (which does not shed it's petals) Mike deduced that they murdered her with a drug overdose and arrested them. Mike next came to the aid of an American soldier who had just returned home from World War II who had been tricked out of ownership of his car by a pair of crooked garage owners. While Mike was unable to recover ownership of the vehicle, he pointed out the mechanics forgery and forced them to pay the soldier a fair amount for the car. Later, Mike and Pepper helped nab Joey Morgan and his gang after they had robbed a post office.

mike white.name: Mike White
mike white.origin: Mike was an adult man of about 40 years, and he usually went to a casino in Reno with Deadpool, Anaconda, and Dong to bet. One time, Desire arrived at the casino and started to cheat Deadpool, saying that all the other players were corrupt. She said that Mike was pedophile and an inveterate drunkard, as a way to deceive Deadpool. In fact, Deadpool said that Mike liked to drink to forget the pain of losing his wife in a tragic accident, and that he was not a pedophile, because he helped his niece by taking her to school in Arizona, and that the real villain of history, was Desire.

mike williams.name: Mike Williams
mike williams.origin: Mike Williams interviewed several people outside Avengers Mansion after the public revelation of Vision and Scarlet Witch's relationship and all got positive reactions, except one from a racist (who turned out to be the leader of the Living Bombs terrorist group) whose comment Mike asked his cameraman to edit out. Mike Williams was present when Ambassador Govan held a public forum to discuss the killing of a group of a group of Atlanteans in an explosion at a warehouse. He attempted to get a comment from Red Dragon on the belief that the visit was really just a glorified prisoner exchange. Williams witnessed Govan being shot by Norman Osborn shortly after the public forum started.

mike zelby.name: Mike Zelby
mike zelby.origin: Mike Zelby was a mobster who learned that Dr. Forbes had discovered gold in Alaska. When Forbes refused to divulge the location of the gold, Zelby had him shot and left in the harsh Alaskan climate. Clinging to life, Forbes stumbled across the home of Jack Frost who vowed to track down Zelby and avenge Forbes' death. Zelby by this time had returned to New York City, where the local authorities were unable to prove he had murdered Forbes. Zelby next targeted Forbes' daughter Alice, kidnapping her and taking her back to his home. There, he threatened her life in order to learn the location of the gold. He never learned its location as his interrogation was interrupted by Jack Frost. During the course of the battle against Frost, a fire started in Zelby's office. Jack Frost and Alice escaped, leaving Zelby and his minions to burn alive.

mikel bulgakov.name: Mikel Bulgakov
mikel bulgakov.origin: Mikel Bulgakov was a Soviet Spetsnaz-trained covert agent operating in the United States where he adopted the identity of Mickey Bonderant. With the fall of the Wall, he thought he was forgotten and so he continued to live in the United States as an honest American citizen until the day he received a phone call ordering him to extract a sleeper agent from Project Zephyr but was surprised by the Winter Soldier and the Black Widow to whom he revealed where the sleeper was located.

mikel fury.name: Mikel Fury
mikel fury.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 50: Wolverine/Nick Fury: The Scorpio Connection
mikel fury.origin: ===Origin=== thumb|left|300px|Mikel's mother Amber D'Alexis preparing to kill both Mikel and Nick Fury Mikel Fury was the son of Nick Fury and Amber D'Alexis. His mother trained him and raised him believing he was Scorpio's son. Following Scorpio's suicide, Mikel followed in Scorpio's footsteps and took on the mantle, complete with an imitation Zodiac Key. Mother and son targeted Nick and attempted to kill him but got Wolverine involved as well. When D'Alexis was restrained by Nick, she revealed that Nick was Mikel's true father, shocking him enough for her to break free. Choosing between his son and Wolverine, Nick hesitantly fired on Mikel, injuring his shoulder. Despite Mikel bleeding out, D'Alexis seized the Zodiac Key and planned to kill both Fury and her own son, reasoning that Mikel would have no life anyway and Fury losing his newly-discovered son would make him suffer even more. Mikel cried out for his mom, though it was not clear if it was out of disbelief or in warning for Wolverine immediately stabbed her, killing her on the spot. Nick convinced Wolverine to spare Mikel, and as the Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., he took Mikel in, planning on healing him both physically and mentally. ===Becoming President=== thumb|right|Political beginnings When civil war broke out in his home country of Carpasia, he stole the Cosmic Key from S.H.I.E.L.D. and became Scorpio again. With the help of Fury and Wolverine, he stopped Hydra's coup d'etat and became acting president of Carpasia. ===The Punisher=== Mikel was unable to prevent corruption in Carpasia's government, so he eventually returned to the States and rejoined S.H.I.E.L.D. as a full agent. Scorpio assisted S.H.I.E.L.D. in the hunt for Frank Castle after he escaped custody, but was unable to prevent the apparent murder of his father, Nick Fury. Scorpio was satisfied when Castle was apparently put to death in the electric chair. After he learned Castle survived his execution, however, Scorpio hunted him down with S.H.I.E.L.D. resources against the orders of his superiors. This led to Mikel being thrown out of S.H.I.E.L.D. altogether. ===Gray Team=== thumb|left|300px|Alexander Pierce, Mikel Fury, and Daisy Johnson Mikel returned to politics and had an office in Moldova. With S.H.I.E.L.D. gone during Norman Osborn's reign, Nick sent Mikel to gather and lead the Gray Team of the Caterpillars. Alongside his friend Carlos Ayala, they recruited Lynn Richards, Red Webo, Sandra Murphy, Jenny and Malcolm Monroe, Bryan Cole, and Robert Martin. They were tasked to research the Soviet shadow organization Leviathan but had difficulty finding anything more than rumors until Nick's breakthrough with Seth Waters. Nick summoned Mikel and the other Caterpillar leaders, Daisy Johnson and Alexander Pierce, to discuss their plans against both Leviathan and Hydra. ===Death=== thumb|right|Nick Fury mourning Mikel A year after being called back into action by his father, Mikel and his team were all killed in a mission to the destroy the Hydra base called the Hive. They had planted a bomb, but the base was being commanded by one of Hydra's leaders, also called the Hive. To prevent the Hive from controlling them with his parasites, Mikel blew up the base in an act of sacrifice while Nick heard his last moments on the comms. Despite having recovered no body, Nicholas made an empty grave for his son and all other members of the team. Soon after, he was in fron of Mikel's tombstone, mourning his loss, when he was captured by Hydra agents. Fury mentioned Mikel's death when executing Baron Strucker in vengeance. Later, Fury told his other son "Marcus Johnson" about Mikel's fate, though Marcus went forward anyway to join S.H.I.E.L.D. as Nick Fury Jr.

mikey castle.name: Mikey Castle
mikey castle.origin: Mikey was a boy who, under the influence of PCP, vivisected his parents. He was taken from a detention center to Psychoville, where he was brainwashed to make him the perfect sleeper assassin. In Psychoville, he became Mikey, the son of Frank Castle, who was also brought there and brainwashed. When Frank was able to overcome the conditioning, Erwin Shane, the head of the Psychoville project, ordered Mikey and the rest of the family to be killed to further traumatize Frank.

mikhail kapuchin.name: Mikhail Kapuchin
mikhail kapuchin.origin: Mikhail Kapuchin was the son of the Russian mafia boss of Little Odessa who was captured and questioned by the Punisher and Spider-Man and revealed a drug deal between his father and a drug dealer. During the negotiation Spider-Man and the Punisher prepared an ambush that led to the arrest of the gang, but from which Mikhail managed to escape. Mikhail later took over from his father as leader of the Russian mafia and took Craig Williams as his henchman, convincing him by telling him that Spider-Man and the Punisher were being paid by him. During one of their theft attempts, while Mikhail was about to kill a warehouse keeper, Spider-Man intervened who defeated the whole gang and had them arrested, including Mikhail and Craig.

mikhail kutuzov.name: Mikhail Kutuzov
mikhail kutuzov.origin: Colonel Kutuzov was a Russian cosmonaut and a member of the space station, Starcore One. He was present for many of the crew’s examination of unusual solar and astronomic events, often tied to alien activities or reality-affecting events on Earth. As such, he was witness to the appearance of an alien ship from behind the sun, and later when the sun’s electromagnetic field became unstable, threatening to cause a nova. Mikhail was present when Quasar boarded Starcore One to ask about the sun’s changes, and left the team an emergency device to contact him in case of emergency after they refused to abandon the station. He was later among the crew when they evacuated the station due to a massive solar flare heading towards it. They escaped In the Starcore life pod, and were rescued by the Avengers thanks to a distress signal sent by Corbeau. A Shi'ar spaceship then emerged from a wormhole/gate which had caused the flare, and opened fire on the Avengers and the pod. The Avengers drove off the Shi’ar and returned the Starcore One staff to Earth. Kutuzov’s current whereabouts and activities are unknown.
