mimir burison.species: Asgardian son of Aesir and of a Frost Giantess
mimir burison.origin: ===Origin=== The Asgardian known as Mimir was the child of Buri and brother of Bor, father of Odin and the Asgardians. Some legends note him as the son of Bestla (Odin's mother) or Bolthorn (Bestla's father), or even Bolthorn's brother (thus possibly Ymir's grandson. ===Aesir/Vanir War=== He was given by Odin to the Vanir as a peace hostage during the Aesir/Vanir War. For unknown reasons, the Vanir decapitated him and send his living, talking head back to Odin. Odin who transformed him into a fiery being. Thereafter, Mimir existed mostly as a disembodied head that dwelled in the Well of Wisdom in Asgard. Odin sacrificed his right eye to Mimir for the wisdom to prevent Ragnarök. Mimir was a virtually omniscient being with precognitive abilities. Thor often traveled to Hildstalf, to seek out the wisdom from the Well of Mimir. Thor sacrificed both his eyes for insight on how to permanently stop Ragnarok.

mimoza.name: Mimoza
mimoza.origin: A soldier in the Shi’ar military, Mimoza, at the order of then-Empress Deathbird, attacked the Starjammers along with others. They distracted them long enough for Deathbird to kidnap her sister Lilandra. Months later, Mimoza and Pupugli, another veteran of that battle, patrolled a quiet fringe planet, commenting on how much better work would be any place else. They were shocked when the Starjammers attacked, inspiring the locals to rebel at the sight of the “bald Phoenix” (Professor X in a Phoenix costume).

min.origin: Min was a girl living on Madripoor, where she was a member of Koh's gang; the few people on Madripoor who resisted the rule of Hideki Kurohagi. When Koh noticed Logan had come to Madripoor, he send Min to meet up with him. She found Logan, who was fighting several armed thugs, and joined the fight, killing several of them with Kunais. Logan initially only tolerated her presence because she could tell him where to find Hideki, but he quickly grew annoyed by her many questions. When Hideki send Vadhaka to attack Logan, Min helped Logan by attacking the statue with a steam pipe that hit him in the eyes, temporarily blinding him and causing him to leave. During Logan's attack on the Dragon Palace, she was killed by Vadhaka. This act of killing a child prompted Kikyo to help Logan destroy Vadhaka.

mina.name: Mina
mina.origin: thumb|left|Leonid transforming Mina In circa 1630, Leonid was born in the Deviant city Ashomia. After Leonid's biological father, Isaac Newton, stole from the Deviants and burned their city, the denizens took their anger on Newton's Deviant mate, Morda. To save her son's life, she gave him to Michelangelo, who then took the baby to the Sinkhole. A pigeon landed on Michelangelo's arm and was touched by Leonid, whose cosmic powers turned her into a humanoid woman. thumb|left|Mina being given Leonid Michelangelo told her that she was chosen and gave her a key that would open Iter, "the door that cannot be opened," located in the Immortal City for Leonid to use later. Before leaving, he informed her that the Sinkhole has special temporal properties and that they must stay there until "the man who hurls lightning," Nikola Tesla, finds this place. After an unspecified amount of time in the Sinkhole, roughly three centuries passed on Earth. Tesla found his way to the Sinkhole and brought Mina and Leonid to Earth, and they became a family. thumb|right|Raising Leonid with Tesla While living in New York City, Tesla and Mina were confronted by the Brotherhood of the Shield agents, Nathaniel Richards and Howard Stark, who were sent by the Brotherhood's leader and Leonid's biological father, Newton. Mina escaped while Tesla was shot and killed, but he was saved by Michelangelo. Mina and Tesla reunited in Rome and she told Tesla about the key to the Iter. thumb|left|Coming to see Leonid at the Immortal City after three years The pair visited their son who had been staying in the Immortal City and the Brotherhood for three years, with Tesla intending to take it down. After giving Leonid the key, Tesla and Mina went to battle Richards and Stark. When Tesla was about to self-destruct, Nathaniel Richards grabbed him and suddenly sent through time to the far future. Mina took care of a dying Tesla for a while until Richards and Stark found her. They agreed on a truce to restore Tesla and use Richards to send them back home. thumb|right|Return to the Immortal City with Tesla, Nathaniel Richards, and Howard Stark When they returned, four years had passed and the Brotherhood of the Shield was in the middle of a civil war between Leonardo da Vinci and Sir Isaac Newton. The latter believed that the world is fated to end in 2060, but the returned time travellers objected his truth. A trial was held for both parties, which ended with Newton escaping to the future with a time machine to prove his theory correct. Newton's ideology corrupted the Star Child who then also travelled to the future. The Brotherhood used the Human Machine to follow them; Mina was among those pursued Newton along with Tesla and Leonid. They arrived at three different versions of 2060 and battled Newton and the corrupted Star Child across all three timelines. Although most of them died in the battle, the Human Machine ascended Leonid who resolved the conflict with Newton and sent them back home fully restored.

Jonathan Hickman & Dustin Weaver's & was delayed in 2011 and was not published for many years, even though the art and colors were done since 2014. mina martin.name: Mina Martin
mina martin.origin: Mina is the daughter of Miles Martin and his first wife. Her father apparently never took care of her and at one point killed her mother; Mina tried to report him, but the police didn't believe her, so she came up with a plan to lure the Black Cat into her father's caveau. Her plan succeeded, but her father discovered her and attempted to kill her. However, the Black Cat was able to rescue her, and gave a police officer she trusted proof that Miles owned stolen artwork, which presumably led to his arrest.

mindbender.origin: After finding a mask in the shape of a brain, a mild-mannered, small-time crook decided to pose as a super-villain, adopting the name of Mindbender. mindee cuckoo.name: Mindee Cuckoo
mindee cuckoo.origin: ===Origin=== While Emma Frost lay in a comatose state, Dr. John Sublime harvested eggs from her to begin experimentation. The Weapon Plus program then used the eggs to create thousands of identical mutant girls in the hope of developing a powerful weapon capable of killing every mutant on Earth by combining their telepathic abilities. The project was designated Weapon XIV, and girls were incubated and artificially aged inside the subterranean level of The World. While most girls remained dormant, five were sent to infiltrate the Xavier Institute as student sisters to hone their talents for Sublime's purpose. ===Xavier Institute=== After the Xavier Institute went public, Mindee and her sisters were enrolled as orphan quintuplet sisters. To protect their secret origins, the girls unconsciously placed mental blocks in the minds of the faculty, preventing them from investigating their background. thumb|left|Mindee and her sisters strutting in the halls of the Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters|Institute The girls quickly gained the moniker "The Stepford Cuckoos", though their chosen codename was the Five-In-One. Emma Frost took a special interest in the girls, and the Cuckoos became her protégés. When Kid Omega led a rebellion of students at the X-Mansion, Sophie encouraged Mindee and the other Cuckoos to take action, and they covertly snuck into Cerebra. Using Kick to amp up her powers, Sophie and her sisters were able to stop Quire. Unfortunately, Sophie died in the process. With the death of Sophie, the Five-In-One became the Four-In-One. The girls were furious with Emma Frost, whom they blamed for Sophie's death. This mourning and anger was multiplied when Esme attempted to murder Emma, fled the X-Mansion, and joined Xorn's Brotherhood. With the departure and later death of Esme, the Four-In-One became the Three-In-One. The girls were among the students temporarily relocated to an X-Corp building in Salem Center while the Institute was being rebuilt. It was here that Mindee's first boyfriend, Germaine, died during an anti-mutant riot. thumb|The Three-In-One as students in the Corsairs Squad (Earth-616)|Corsairs Squad When the Institute was rebuilt under the leadership of co-headmasters Cyclops and Emma Frost, the students were organized into several training squads with an assigned mentor staff member. Mindee and her sisters were assigned to the Corsairs Squad under the tutelage of Cyclops with the girls serving equally as co-leaders of the squad. ===M-Day=== On M-Day the vast majority of the world's mutant population was depowered. Mindee and her sisters retained their powers, but they were three of only twenty-seven students to retain their powers. Fearing for the students' safety, Emma Frost ordered that the depowered students and staff leave the Institute. For their safety, the depowered students were brought through the Morlock Tunnels to an awaiting bus. Unfortunately, the bus of depowered students was bombed by anti-mutant zealot Rev. William Stryker, killing all forty-two of the former students on board. The remaining students were placed by Emma Frost into an all-out brawl, and the ones deemed the best by Emma would become a group of New X-Men in-training. This entire exercise was met with disgust by the Three-In-One, who promptly informed Cyclops of Emma's actions. ===Warsong=== When an unstable fraction of the Phoenix Force sparked inside the girls, the dormant Weapon Plus nanotech inside their bones was activated. This nanotech briefly reanimated Sophie and Esme, who directed their sisters back to The World to activate Sublime's plan for the destruction of the mutant race. thumb|left|Mindee being pulled into Sublime (Earth-616)|Sublime's Weapon Plus machine The Phoenix and Sublime both wrestled for control of the Cuckoos when the X-Men arrived. Mindee appeared apathetic and consigned to her fate as part of Sublime's weapon. Soon Phoebe was captured and integrated into Sublime's machine, but the Phoenix was able to possess Celeste. When Celeste was finally merged into the machine, the Phoenix was divided between all the Cuckoos and trapped in their newly emerged second mutation, organic diamond hearts. This event finally activated the Thousand-In-One. Celeste continued to resist the Phoenix and Sublime's machine long enough for the X-Men to forcibly disconnect them. In a rage, Phoebe triggered a power surge that caused an explosion, but Celeste was able take full control of the Phoenix. Celeste destroyed her new sisters, and trapped the Phoenix fragments inside the Three-In-One's flawless diamond hearts rendering them emotionless. ===Endangered Species=== After returning to the Institute, the girls adopted a rebellious/mischievous streak. They helped Elixir telepathically gain a Ph.D. level knowledge of science and biology from Beast's brain. Along with the other students, they were pulled into Limbo, where they were rescued by Prodigy. To repay his kindness, the Cuckoos restored all of the kn

fields.notes: Mindee's first boyfriend, Germaine, died during an anti-mutant riot while the students were temporarily housed in an X-Corp building in Salem Center. Mindee later had a brief yet combative flirtation with Jay Guthrie, who repeatedly interrupted her while she was practicing the piano. Mindee has also shown an interest in Christopher Muse. Mindee was the second Cuckoo to change her appearance radically, behind her late sister Esme.
fields.trivia: This character is first identified as Mindee in . However, later Matt Fraction retconned Mindee's name to actually be Irma to comply with creator Grant Morrison's original desire for first letters the quintuplet's first names to spell "SPICE", hence Sophie, Phoebe, Irma (or Mindee), Celeste, and Esme. Her real name, seems to have been revealed (apparently as originally intended by Morrison) in . Mindee enjoys playing piano.

mindmeld.name: Mindmeld
mindmeld.origin: Along with Clearcut, Mindmeld was employed by Shinobi Shaw as a personal bodyguard and protector. When X-Force interfered with Shinobi's plans, Mindmeld used her powers to switch the bodies of the team, giving her group the advantage. After Clear-Cut's betrayal, Mindmeld immediately attacked him, placing her mind into her former ally's body. She then proceeded to knock herself out, and when she awoke, she found herself in Shinobi's new experiment chamber. Shinobi was willing to test his machine on Clear-Cut, despite Mindmeld currently inhabiting his body. She eventually returned to her former body, but found an Inhibitor Collar around her neck. Meltdown then knocked her unconscious. It is unknown if she returned to the service Shinobi Shaw after she was betrayed, nor if she retained her powers after the Decimation.

mindrot.name: Mindrot
mindrot.origin: Mindrot is a member of a race of galactic nomads who wander the vast corridors of space in the early stage of their life cycle. Searching out life-bearing planets, Mindrot arrived on planet Earth millions of years ago, long before the arrival of man. He waited in the deep ocean waiting for his prey to evolve to the point of feeling the smell of synthetic toxins and non-natural substances, as proof that the species had evolved to the point of getting technology, reason and conscience and this did awaken him making the human race his prey.

mindy glidewell.name: Mindy Glidewell
mindy glidewell.origin: Little is detailed about Mandy’s life before the zombie plague arrived on Earth-2149, however she is somehow rescued by Magneto, and kept safe with an ever-decreasing band of survivors in the New York subway system. When Magneto returns from a sortie to find medicines and supplies with another meta-human, her dad, and police officer Kelly Ridge reacted aggressively towards him believing him to be infected, but Mindy reassured them. They learned from Reed that there is a teleportation device in the Baxter Building, but while Magneto initially favored destroying it to contain the infection, Mindy suggested that they could actually use it to escape this world for Reed's. Just then, a super-powered zombie horde crashed into the subway station, and they had to make a dash for the rear exit to have any hope of escaping to Reed's universe. Outside the back door, and even bigger mass of zombies waited for them, but right on time, Reed's friends arrived. Sue temporarily blinded the horde, while Johnny, and Ben burned and clobbered a path through to the Baxter Building, where the survivors escaped using the teleport, leaving behind Magneto to destroy the device.

mindy williams.name: Mindy Williams
mindy williams.origin: Mindy Williams dated Kyle Richmond while they were both studying at Grayburn College. When she was severely injured in a car accident that Kyle had caused by driving drunk, his father used his money and influence to cover up the accident, sending the now-crippled Mindy away and leaving Kyle to believe that she had died in the accident. Years later, she revealed herself to Kyle, in an attempt to kill him for what he did, but she wasn't able to do what she wanted in the end. After that event, Nighthawk brought her to a mental hospital. After some time (during which Kyle was left paraplegic during sunshine because of magic), Richmond visited Mindy at the hospital, but when he got close, she manifested her powers moving him away from her via telepathy; a shocked Kyle decided to come back that night as Nighthawk in order to learn more. He discovered that the "hospital" hosted an ammount of technologically advanced machinery, mostly used to make experiments on the patients, expecially on Mindy. Nighthawk broke into the hospital, but it's "director", August Masters, seize the opportunity to test Mindy's powers against the one she hated the most. Mindy was able to summon some sort of mind demons that attacked her former lover, but Kyle was eventually able to apologize for what he did to her, convincing her to use her powers against Masters and the "staff" of the hospital as well. That resulted in the destruction of most of the building. Soon after those events, Masters kidnapp the girl again, as part of a plan to use the power of six telepaths (included Mindy) to launch a telepathic attack to Soviet Union, killing the whole population. When the efforts of both Captain America and the Defenders weren't able to stop Masters, a seemingly-comatose Mindy was successfull in sending a telapthic message to Doctor Strange, who assembled a new Defenders squad to rescue their friends. Meanwhile, the six telepaths had eventually decided that their powers were too dangerous for humanity and they wanted to self-destroy Masters' secret headquarter, using Kyle's body as their way to do that; Strange casted a spell to save everyone in that place, but was unable to prevent the telepaths from making their prison explode. However, that wasn't the end for Mindy, as the explosion fused the telepaths into the entity known as Chorus.

Mindy's telepathic attack was strong enough to incapacitate Spider-Man, but the effect scared her into surrendering. She wanted to hurt Nighthawk, not to hurt innocent people. She also figured out that she was unable to control her own explosive anger.
fields.trivia: Mindy's telepathy was left unexplained in her original stories. It manifested at some point in her early adulthood. She was apparently born with the ability, and she may be a mutant. As a wheelchair-bound telepath, Mindy serves as a female counterpart to Professor X.

mini max.name: Mini Max
mini max.origin: Mini Max was a part of a mercenary team known as the Scourge who was tasked to help Deadpool capture the mutant, Wolverine for their benefactor the Administrator. After destroying a pub where Logan was located, Mini Max and the others confronted him in a full on battle which ended when the Administrator showed up and knocked Wolverine unconscious. After some time had past, the interdimensional traveler Major X arrived at Cape Elizabeth in Maine, where he was confronted by Mini Max and the rest of the Scourge under the leadership of Dreadpool. Mini Max jumped on top of Major X's head but he ended up being swung into his teammate Mega Max as the Major shot a barrage of bullets at Mini Max resulting in his apparent death.

mink.name: Mink
mink.origin: Mink was a student at John Hathorne High School in Salem, Massachusetts, a town split between magic-using families referred to as "Wicks" and those without magical abilities, called "Blanks". Mink was a "Wick" with the power to create curses, a power he felt was too aggressive to suit his more passive nature. When Francis Foley, Mink's friend with precognitive powers, foresaw the coming of a disaster and believed a new student in their school, Kim Vesco was to be their savior, Mink doubted him but agreed to help guide the unaware Vesco anyways. Foley turned out to be right as their classmate Chad Barrow turned out to be the Thief, a prophesied parasitic magical mutation looking to take control of all the magic in Salem. Mink, Foley, their friend LB Harrington, and rival coven Mason Kaleema, Paul Aristides, and Ren Lowell, joined together around Vesco to oppose the Thief and save Salem.

minn erva.name: Minn-Erva
minn erva.species: Kree Mutate, exposed to the Psyche-Magnitron and enhanced with Inhuman genetic engineering
minn erva.origin: ===The War Between the Three Galaxies=== Doctor Minerva was a Kree bio-scientist subordinated to the Supreme Science Council. Obsessed with solving the genetic stagnation her species faced, she evaluated a solution in the exiled hero Captain Mar-Vell, whose altered genes were seen as a way to progress the Kree genetic code. Having travelled to Earth to spy on Mar-Vell, she secretly orbited the planet in her science Starcruiser while collecting intel. In order to attract his attention and force his compliance, Minerva kidnapped his sidekick Rick Jones. Coming to Jones' rescue, Mar-Vell learned about Minerva's plans for him. However, her superior Phae-Dor interrupted her mission, ordering her to return to Kree-Lar with the traitor Mar-Vell captive. Doctor Minerva refused to accept the orders and was violently knocked out. Her ship was taken by Phae-Dor, who went on to attack Captain Mar-Vell by himself. At the cost of the ship, Mar-Vell fended Phae-Dor off. Having been rescued by Captain Mar-Vell, Doctor Minerva joined him in order to prevent the war between the three galaxies Phae-Dor had mentioned. Approached by the Inhumans and the Kree scientist Falzon, Doctor Minerva revealed her plans of saving the Kree from genetic stagnation to make they socially evolve past their obsession with war. This prompted Captain Mar-Vell to confront the Supreme Science Council and end their operations, which were secretly influenced by Skrulls. Stranded on Earth, Doctor Minerva was joined by a fellow scholar from the Kree Science Academy, Mac-Ronn. She took the opportunity to manipulate the Accuser Ronan, who had been under Mac-Ronn's care since he had had his mind erased in a previous battle with Mar-Vell. Ronan was eventually restored by the Supreme Intelligence and escaped from Mac-Ronn and Minerva. ===Kree-Shi'ar War=== Inspired by the local genetic variability, Doctor Minerva was able to empower herself on Earth as a champion through the Psyche-Magnitron machine. Recognizing her value, the Kree Empire commissioned the warrior Captain Atlas to partner her in her quest for glory. Next, she focused on acquiring the Quantum Bands that empowered the hero Quasar. Masqueraded as humans, the two Kree agents offered a large sum of money for A.I.M. in exchange for designing replicas of the artifacts, but they failed. Doctor Minerva then incapacitated Quasar herself with a Synthetic Disrupter Gun and marched with Captain Atlas away from Earth in a Starcruiser. Unable to remove the Quantum Bands from Quasar's organism, Doctor Minerva chose to sever his forearms. This caused Quasar to wake up in desperation and oppose her. Doctor Minerva and Captain Atlas were subdued by Quasar, who demanded them not to approach Earth again. Despite this threat, Doctor Minerva and Captain Atlas resurfaced on Titan to desecrate Mar-Vell's tomb, in search for his Nega-Bands. Their motivation came from the fact that the Kree were at territorial war with the Shi'ar Empire. Sensing the violation, Quasar and Starfox stopped them. However, the Shi'ar Imperial Guard intervened. During the commotion, Doctor Minerva had Captain Atlas steal the Nega-Bands. Upon their activation, Captain Atlas traded places with Rick Jones as Doctor Minerva was restrained by Quasar and taken into the Avengers' custody. The Shi'ar Guardsman Hobgoblin impersonated Minerva to trick Captain Atlas and secure the Nega-Bands for the Shi'ar. The incident allowed the real Doctor Minerva to escape. Being praised by the Supreme Intelligence, Doctor Minerva and Captain Atlas joined the Starforce, an elite strikeforce aimed at protecting the Kree Empire from the Shi'ar and the Avengers. Their intervention restored the Intelligence's rule over the Kree and led to the arrest of the Avengers. Manipulated by Skrulls, the Shi'ar used the Nega-Bands to empower the Nega-Bomb and obliterate the Kree space territories. Most of the Kree population was decimated with the detonation. The war was then revealed to have been an elaborate plan schemed by the Supreme Intelligence. Doctor Minerva and Captain Atlas were subdued by the Avengers as one of the few survivors of the massacre. As a geneticist working closely with the Intelligence, Doctor Minerva had been aware of the plan all along, supporting the trigger for the Kree evolution through its genocide. In horror, Captain Atlas was distraught with his partner. Seemingly suicidal over the revelation, he activated a self-destruct mechanism which resulted in a blast that apparently consumed himself and Doctor Minerva. In fact, Captain Atlas had bluffed, and the two teleported away under the cover of his suicide. Resurfacing on an uninhabited planet, Doctor Minerva resumed her schemes of improving the Kree race. Although Captain Atlas was somehow resentful about her actions, he still sided with her. They were found by the Silver Surfer by chance, but managed to evade him by falsely alleging they wished to cope with the Kree decimation by themselves at peac

minnie floyd.name: Minnie Floyd
minnie floyd.origin: Minnie was the daughter of Ken and Sally Floyd, and also a mutant with the power to reverse her aging uncontrollably. Her parents first observed her age regression as a misjudgement, but soon reconsidered and took her to doctors who confirmed the fact. She died as a result of her power, as her parents and the doctors were helpless to stop the age regression. Minnie's death drove her mother to drink heavily and reject her husband. As an act of acceptance and reconstruction, her mother wrote an article about her after the M-Day in her Ex-Mutant diaries.

minos.name: Minos
minos.origin: ===Origin and early Life=== King Minos was the king of Crete. Minos was the son of Zeus, the king of the gods, and of Europa, a Phoenician princess. Minos obtained the Cretan throne by the aid of the Greek god Poseidon, and from Knossos he gained control over the Aegean islands, colonizing many of them and ridding the sea of pirates. He married Pasiphaë. Minos successfully warred against Athens to obtain redress after his son Androgeos was killed by the Athenians. ===Minotaur=== His wife Pasiphaë slept with the Bull of Crete sent by Zeus, and gave birth to Minotaur, a creature half man – half bull. King Minos was embarrassed, but did not want to kill the Minotaur, so he hid the monster in the Labyrinth constructed by Daedalus at the Minoan Palace of Knossos. Angrodes, son of Minos, went to Athens to participate to the Panathenaic Games, but he was killed during the Marathon by the bull that impregnated his mother. Minos was infuriated, and demanded Aegus, king of Athens, to send seven men and women every year to the Minotaur to advert the plague caused by the death of Androgeus. ===Theseus=== Later Theseus insisted on being one of the seven youths and seven maidens of Athens to be sacrificed to the monster as an annual tribute. He promised his father that if he were successful in killing the Minotaur he would on his return voyage replace his ship's black sails with white ones. Ariadne, daughter of King Minos, fell in love with Theseus and gave him a magic ball of thread to be dropped at the entrance of the labyrinth; it led Theseus to the Minotaur, which he killed, and he then followed the unwound thread back to the entrance. ===Death=== Having pursued Daedalus to Sicily, Minos was killed by the daughters of King Cocalus, who poured boiling water over him as he was taking a bath. After his death he became a judge in Hades, the Underworld.

minouru kawade.name: Minouru Kawade
minouru kawade.origin: Minouru Kawade and his wife Deanna lived in Atlanta, Georgia with their son Kei, an avid fan of monsters who liked to spend his time drawing them. When the Terrigen Cloud swept through town, it activated latent Inhuman genes within Kei who then entered into a cocoon and underwent Terrigenesis, transforming him into a NuHuman with the ability to summon the monsters he drew. At first, neither Minouru nor Deanna believed their son had acquired powers, because there were no outward signs. When Xemnu suddenly destroyed his place of business, the family was forced to relocate to St. Louis, Missouri in order for him to find work. After a second monster attack, Minouru and Deanna began to suspect their son, and commenced moving around the country to avoid attracting attention to the monsters' connection with Kei, with their latest home being in Springfield. During the Leviathon Tide's invasion, Kei was kidnapped by occult expert Elsa Bloodstone to use his ability to summon monsters independent of the Tide to fight off the invasion. The superheroes Elsa took Kei to later reunited his parents with him at the Baxter Building, which had become their base of operations during the tide. Following the defeat of the Tide and their leader, the Leviathon Mother, Kei was given an entire island the Inhumans created for him, named Mu, which served as his and his parent's home, as well as a refuge for the monsters of his own creation.

mints.name: Mints
mints.origin: Mints was a member of the Brooklyn Avengers who, like the other residents of Mr. Furlong's building, gained mild powers after being exposed to a radioactive pesticide sprayed on the building by Furlong. They fought crime alongside Spider-Man, who was just starting his superhero career, but Spider-Man quickly left the team, considering them disorganized and a danger to themselves. Years later, Mints died after suffering a heart attack on the street, but because she was old, everyone assumed her death was natural, except Psi, another member of the Brooklyn Avengers, who believed Rotary's death was caused. This turned out to be true, and the cause was Mr. Furlong himself, who, disguised as Red Hook, a former enemy of the Brooklyn Avengers, was intent on getting rid of his tenants so he could sell the building.

minxi.name: Minxi
minxi.species: Inhuman subjected to the Terrigen Mists
minxi.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 39: The Inhumans
minxi.origin: ===Early years=== Minxi was born to a pickpocket mother and a bootlegger father. She might have been a villain at some time in her past. ===Handmaiden of the Queen=== ====Pregnant Medusa==== Minxi worked as maid for Queen Medusa, but tried to spy on her and Black Bolt for someone else. When a pregnant Medusa fled from Attilan as the Genetic Council passed judgment on her unborn baby and Black Bolt would not intervene, Minxi accompanied and cared for her, using her powers to take animal form and hunt for food. They were soon joined by the rest of the Inhuman Royal Family. She was shocked by Crystal who used her elemental powers to purify the air (as the Genetic Council had already judged against that), while Gorgon left, infuriated. As the other Royals were enjoying Crystal's doing, Minxi touched a bird and flew away to find Gorgon. During that period, Karnak was in love with Minxi, while showing only defiance and arrogance towards her. She soon returned as an elemental monster attacked them, serving as a distraction for Karnak, Gorgon and Crystal to destroy it, and immediately cared for Medusa as she went in labor. ====After Ahura's birth==== After that time, Karnak tried to get close to Minxi, in vain, as Gorgon was seemingly already in relationship with her, and chased him from her company. When they returned to Attilan, Minxi feared that Gorgon could not pursue their relation. When Medusa's son Ahura was returned to Attilan to be tried by the Genetics Council and Gorgon felt sorry for Black Bolt as Medusa refused to stand near him, Minxi defended Medusa, highlighting the fact that Black Bolt had delivered her son twice to the Council. Minxi was present when Medusa and She-Hulk fought over a Future Foundation matter, but was told to stay away from the fight by her Queen. ====After Attilan destruction==== Minxi was one of three Royal Attendants to Queen Medusa who was invited to stay at Avengers Tower after their city Attilan fell from the forces of Thanos and his Black Order.

mirage.name: Mirage
mirage.origin: Mirage was the daughter of Oblivion, who created her out of himself to appease his own loneliness. To escape her father, Mirage used Bounce-Boxes to travel through time and space. Disguised as Marge Smith, she lived with her "family" (her creations) next door to Bobby Drake's parents. Bobby encountered her when he went home for his dad's retirement party and was attracted to her; however, Oblivion sent his minions White Light and Idiot to retrieve her. Marge's house was destroyed in the fight and she disappeared. She retreated to 1892, England as Margaret, but her "brother" accidentally left behind one of their Bounce-Boxes. This sent Bobby back in time to meet his own parents when they were young. Another one of Oblivion's minions, Kali, was tracking the Bounce-Boxes and attacked him by mistake. Mirage diverted Kali's attention but could not save Bobby's father, preventing Bobby's birth. As Bobby ceased to exist, he went to Oblivion, who tasked him to retrieve his daughter. Marge used Bobby's idea of a perfect town to create one and revealed to Bobby that she was in love with him. However, she was mentally troubled from Oblivion and almost killed Bobby. She swore vengeance against her father but this accidentally caused her to return home. Oblivion explained to Mirage that she was him and he was her. Iceman recovered and struck Oblivion down. At this moment, Mirage realized the truth and accepted Oblivion. She was an echo of Oblivion's self and her defiance was all part of his elaborate plan to give meaning to her love of him, which awakened upon seeing his apparent defeat, as love is nothing without hate. Despite achieving his daughter's love, Oblivion remained unfulfilled. He consumed Iceman, but to his surprise, Bobby resisted Oblivion and re-emerged. Oblivion gained a new understanding of love and "glimpsed a power that transcends and empowers both Oblivion and [...] reality." After sending Bobby home, Oblivion merged with Mirage and the two became one once more.

mirage telepath.name: Mirage (Telepath)
mirage telepath.origin: Mirage was imprisoned in Thunderbolts Mountain for violating the Superhuman Registration Act. She and her cohorts infiltrated the prison deliberately to undermine the Thunderbolts. Together, the four attempted to gain intel on the prison so that they could plan an escape. In her probing, Mirage noted that Penance was having violent episodes and the team of Thunderbolts was under extreme stress as a result. She also found Doc Samson to have an interesting mind, and tried to dig deeper into it. Samson eventually felt her probing and created a psychic backlash with his rage, painfully breaking the connection. When Bullseye began killing her allies by throwing scalpels into their heads, Mirage tried to psychically stop him, but was unable to. She died in the same manner they did.

mirah qadir.name: Mirah Qadir
mirah qadir.origin: Mirah is the mother of the mutant Sooraya Qadir aka Dust. As a child Sooraya was kidnapped and then sold into slavery. After Sooraya was freed, she tried to find her mother, but all attempts were unsuccessful until she met Kingmaker, who used his connections to find Mirah and give them a long-awaited meeting. Kingmaker promised to help Mirah to move to the US, but after Dust and the Hellions Squad broke the deal Mirah was transferred to another camp, and all traces of her were lost again.

miranda.name: Miranda
miranda.origin: left|thumb|Andrea's multiple personalities Andrea Rodgers was a troubled teenager whose difficult upbringing, marked by parental conflict, religious guilt, repression, and emotional trauma, contributed to the fragmentation of her psyche into five distinct personalities. During a camping trip in the swamps near Citrusville, the mystical energies surrounding the Nexus of Realities intensified her inner conflict, causing her alternate selves to manifest physically. These personae included Circe, embodying Andrea's sensual desires; Miranda, representing reason and self-control; Patti, the frightened child within her; Snake, her aggressive and masculine traits; and the She-Demon, the living expression of her rage, resentment, and suppressed hostility. Acting independently, the personalities repeatedly placed Andrea in danger and often came into conflict with one another. When the manifestations spiraled out of control, the Man-Thing instinctively recognized them as fractured portions of a single soul. One by one, he forced the personalities back into Andrea, reuniting the divided aspects of her identity. With her psyche restored, Andrea sought medical and psychological help, hoping at last to become a whole person.

During a camping trip in the swamps near Citrusville, the mystical energies surrounding the Nexus of Realities intensified her inner conflict, causing her alternate selves to manifest physically. These personae included Circe, embodying Andrea's sensual desires; Miranda, representing reason and self-control; Patti, the frightened child within her; Snake, her aggressive and masculine traits; and the She-Demon, the living expression of her rage, resentment, and suppressed hostility. Acting independently, the personalities repeatedly placed Andrea in danger and often came into conflict with one another. When the manifestations spiraled out of control, the Man-Thing instinctively recognized them as fractured portions of a single soul. One by one, he forced the personalities back into Andrea, reuniting the divided aspects of her identity. With her psyche restored, Andrea sought medical and psychological help, hoping at last to become a whole person.

miranda leevald.name: Miranda Leevald
miranda leevald.origin: Miranda grew up in a Texas trailer park and was popular at school until her mutant powers manifested. Fleeing from her abusive family and having no job skills and no money to support herself, she survived through sex work. She used her mutant abilities for her benefit, first on the streets and later when she was scouted by Madame Drache of the X-Ranch. Soon the congregates and leaders of the mutant-hating Church of Humanity attacked the mutant brothel where Miranda worked and burned it to the ground. The X-Men, who were investigating the Ranch at the time, managed to save her, but all her colleagues were killed and the Ranch was destroyed. After that, Stacy joined the X-Men. Stacy had to confront the Church members who sought her demise. During one of her first missions, Stacy was accidentally teleported by a member of the Church to their cathedral headquarters. The X-Men arrived and rescued her before any harm could be done by the Church and its leader the Supreme Pontiff. After a few missions, she quit the team, and left behind a video of herself jumping rope naked for Archangel. thumb|left|200px|As Ripcord Stacy X lost her mutant powers due to M-Day and returned to the streets and sex work. During this time, she was very depressed for losing her powers. She was later recruited into Night Thrasher's newest incarnation of the New Warriors, who provided her with a suit with built-in tentacles, presumably made of steel or a harder metal. She was apparently killed during a confrontation with S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Cape Killers. Despite this, Miranda eventually resurfaced alive. She began to use makeup to imitate her lost scaly appearance to cope with the absence of her powers. Seeking a reason to live, Stacy X attended the first meeting of Mindfulness of Mutant Appearances, a support group set up by Domino and Nightcrawler for mutants unable to pass as normal humans. After fellow attendee Briquette took issue with the normal-looking Stacy X's presence, Stacy X opened up about her depressive state and coping mechanism. Briquette reconciled with and embraced Stacy X as the meeting closed. Following the establishment of a mutant-only nation in Krakoa, Stacy X rejoined her kin and regained her powers. She began operating in the Bower, a place frequented by Krakoans who didn't feel like they fit in where they could vent their frustrations. She also ran a daycare for abandoned mutant babies. At a later point in time, she was apparently imprisoned in the Graymalkin Prison. She was subsequently freed thanks to the X-Men.

miranda mantega.name: Miranda Mantega
miranda mantega.origin: Miranda Mantega was a mother of Sofia Mantega (Wind Dancer). She never told Walter Barrett — Sofia's father — about their daughter and raised her single handedly. She was a loving mother and cared deeply about her daughter, even when Sofia developed mutant powers. One day Miranda went to Caracas to buy a present for her daughter. There was a riot in town and Miranda became its unfortunate victim; she died in a stampede.

miranda manuel.name: Miranda Manuel
miranda manuel.origin: Two years ago, D-Cel was once an ordinary teenager until her mutant powers manifested while traveling with her parents. Their car was slowed down, resulting in it getting hit by a truck. Her parents were killed, and D-Cel was in a coma for three months. She denied being a mutant so she didn't have to blame herself for her parents' deaths. After being moved around between aunts and uncles for a year, she ran away and became homeless. She lived with other homeless teenagers around a series of abandoned buildings in Manhattan. She often pulled pranks with her powers in order to get views on social media. She got the attention of the Juggernaut when she used his powers on him. Believing that she was a mutant, Marko looked for her, wanting to help her. After another confrontation with D-Cel, Cain figured out how D-Cel's powers worked and fought against her until she wore herself out, but he then lost control and crashed into a wall, burying himself and D-Cel under rubble. Marko managed to dig D-Cel out and took D-Cel to Bellevue Hospital to recover. He watched over, and she claimed that she wasn't a mutant. D-Cel became an ally of Juggernaut and aided him and Damage Control apprehend the Hulk in North Carolina who was feared as a threat. The Hulk was captured after getting knocked by Juggernaut once he was weakened by D-Cel's powers and Damage Control's gamma-absorbing device. The Hulk eventually escaped, and Juggernaut and D-Cel went back to New York City where Juggernaut discovered that he was being sued for $25 million by Carmine Angelo whose construction company Juggernaut bankrupted during a battle with Spider-Man. D-Cel attended the trial between Juggernaut and Angelo when the proceedings were interrupted by Quicksand. Quicksand was targeting D-Cel, knowing that she was a mutant. Quicksand was eventually subdued by D-Cel, Juggernaut, and Damage Control. The employees of Damage Control discovered that Quicksand had been mind-controlled by the Nazi scientist Arnim Zola, who was working for the company Absolution Solutions to experiment on superhuman prisoners. Juggernaut then went after Arnim Zola who was operating in a former bunker formerly used by Factor-3 in North Dakota. D-Cel and Damage Control aided Juggernaut, but when Juggernaut was captured, D-Cel went to aid to Juggernaut. However, she was also captured by Arnim Zola's shapeshifting android Primus. Knowing that D-Cel was a mutant, he was about to experiment on her when Juggernaut broke free from his prison and defeated Primus and Zola and rescued D-Cel. D-Cel wanted revenge on Zola, but because Zola was being controlled by Absolution Solutions, Juggernaut convinced D-Cel to spare Zola. Before attacking Absolution Solutions' prison for superhumans, D-Cel was forced by Juggernaut to admit that she was a mutant and explain her backstory. The next day, D-Cel and Juggernaut attacked Dungeon Max Penitentiary 25 miles away from Tucumcari, New Mexico. The pair discovered that the penitentiary was actually a front and was used simply as a place to transport prisoners to another prison called the Dungeon through the use of a teleporter. Juggernaut left D-Cel behind and went through the teleporter. D-Cel went through shortly after and rescued Juggernaut after he was immobilized. When they tried leaving, they discovered that the Dungeon was actually a S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier that was converted into a prison. To prevent D-Cel from being detained and experimented on, Juggernaut convinced her to reveal her mutant status and ask for asylum on Krakoa. Juggernaut later arranged to have D-Cel move to Krakoa. At some point, she was enrolled by Bishop in his War College program.

fields.notes: D-Cel is a frequent user of the video platform YouRoxx. D-Cel is apparently a fan of the novel Read Between the Lines by Jo Knowles as she wore a T-shirt with the novel's name emblazoned on it. D-Cel has denied being a mutant many times, while various tests done by Damage Control and Arnim Zola have stated otherwise. It was later revealed that she is indeed a mutant but refused to accept it due to the fact that when her powers activated, they caused an accident that resulted in her parents' death.

miranda pritchett.name: Miranda Pritchett
miranda pritchett.origin: Miranda Pritchett appeared to have been in a romantic relationship with Steven Rogers, though she apparently did not know his secret identity of Captain America. Jessica Jones was hired by a woman posing as her sister who claimed that she was very worried about Miranda. The woman claimed that since getting involved with a new boyfriend, she had been making many radical life changes such as moving apartments and quitting her job. She hired Jessica to find her sister, stating that she just wanted to know that she was OK. Jessica agreed to take on the case and staked out Miranda's new apartment, taking video of her and her new boyfriend in the process. When the boyfriend received a message on his pager and suddenly left Miranda's apartment, Jessica videotaped him changing into his secret identity on the rooftop. After making this realization, Jessica became very skeptical of the motives of Miranda's "sister" and discovered that the phone number that she had been given by her was currently disconnected. Similarly, the address provided was a commercial storefront for a baby clothes store. Upon returning to Miranda's apartment building she found the police already there, having received an anonymous tip that a woman had been strangled to death. The woman was Miranda Pritchett and the police soon received another anonymous tip which implicated Jessica in her death. As a result, Jessica was taken in for questioning about her knowledge of Miranda's death.

miranda rand.name: Miranda Rand
miranda rand.origin: ===Early Life=== Miranda Rand-K'ai was the the older half-sister of Danny Rand, the current wielder of the Iron Fist, as the daughter of Wendell Rand and Shakirah. Rand's adoptive brother Nu-An was in love with Shakirah as well, which caused him to drive both the woman and her child from the city. She was a highly skilled fighter taught in K'un-Lun by Lord Conal D'hu-Tsien. ===Test of the Many and the One=== A week before the Test of the Many and the One, Danny was ambushed by Merrin and his men, but he benefited from some unexpected help from a masked woman who fought with the skill of the demon. She was unmasked and it revealed to the Many that they were being beaten by a woman. The H'ylithri wanted her to retrieve the Scorpio Key from a S.H.I.E.L.D. facility so it could provide the unique sustenance the H'ylthri needed to survive. Death Sting and Conal D'hu-Tsien, now going by the name Sharyad, hired Sidewinder to steal the Scorpio Key, but he was killed in the process. miranda wilson.name: Miranda Wilson
miranda wilson.origin: Miranda Wilson was an attractive, red-haired actress who played the leading role in a film for which Quentin Beck was part of a special effects team. While a scene was being filmed on the Brooklyn Bridge, a special effect got out of control, causing a helicopter to become damaged and crash on top of Miranda's car. Beck was webbed up by Spider-Man and sent to prison, while Miranda went missing. During the incident, Miranda weakly fell off the Brooklyn Bridge into the water below. Upon making it to shore, Miranda saw in the reflection of the tide that she was left horrendously scarred on one side of her face after the incident. She entered the catacombs underneath Wonder Studios to hide her face where she succumbed to her untreated injuries and began to die. However, she was found by Beck (who had become Mysterio by this point) and wired Miranda to a life support system in order to save her life while converting her to a cyborg. As a result of Miranda's apparent disappearance, Mary Jane Watson was cast in the leading role for the rest of the movie. Meanwhile, Quentin and Miranda created a device which Miranda could use to eventually swap bodies with Mary Jane, who strongly resembled her in appearance. Miranda was stationed in the catacombs of Wonder Studios, where Mary Jane was to be filmed. As Mysterio, Beck lured Mary Jane into the catacombs, where she was captured by Miranda. However, Mysterio revealed to Miranda that the machine was secretly never designed to work, since swapping bodies with Mary Jane would be a scientific impossibility. Quentin lied because "wishing for this day was the only thing that kept [her] alive". He claimed that he had fallen in love with her, and wanted to be with her just the way she was. Miranda agreed to let Mary Jane go, but this caused the energy source for the complex to overload and explode. As the building began to explode, Spider-Man saved Mary Jane from the complex, but Miranda was unable to leave due to her life support system, even if she wanted to since there's nothing left for her. Quentin stayed with Miranda and the two perished in the explosion.

miriam fry.name: Miriam Fry
miriam fry.origin: Miriam Fry was the strict supervisor of the Griffith Boarding House in the 1940s. As the boarding house was exclusive to working women, Miriam did not allow any men past the first floor, even throwing out one of her tenants after the girl's boyfriend climbed into her apartment at night. Peggy Carter had to pass an interview with Miriam before she was allowed to move into the boarding house. Miriam later caught Peggy in the laundry room during the early morning and suspected that she had a man hiding in the dumbwaiter. After escorting Peggy to her room, Miriam had her check the dumbwaiter, only to find a dufflebag inside. When SSR agents arrived at the Griffith, they forced their way past Miriam, who futilely attempted to uphold her rules. She followed them up to Peggy's room and was more appalled to see that Peggy had put a hole in her wall than her tenant pulling a disappearing act. Peggy was subsequently captured and Miriam watched along with her tenants as she was taken away.

miriam sharpe.name: Miriam Sharpe
miriam sharpe.origin: Miriam Sharpe was the mother of Damien Sharpe, one of the kids that died in the explosion caused by Nitro and the New Warriors in Stamford that killed more than 600 people. After the death of her son, Ms. Sharpe became very vocal about heroes needing proper training and accountability. During a Washington debate about the Superhuman Registration Act, Ms. Sharpe slapped Tony Stark, who was initially against the law passing, and gave him Damien's favorite toy, an Iron Man action figure. This was the turning point of Tony Stark's view about the Registration policy. From that point she became a fiery advocate of Iron Man's point of view during the first Superhuman Civil War, helping him during interviews and bad-mouthing Steve Rogers and his Secret Avengers. At the same time, she opened Damien's Gift, a non-profit organization that helped the people who lost their loved ones during superhumans' fights. When the Registration Policy was struck down after the Siege of Asgard, she kept working against superheroes' actions. But her point of view changed during the invasion of the Serpent and the Worthy, when she saw that mankind needed heroes, but also needed to do things for themselves without waiting for the help of superhumans. She also forgave Speedball after he helped Stamford survive the War of the Serpent.

mirmir.name: Mirmir
mirmir.origin: Not much is known of King Mirmir, only that he lived in a land far removed from Asgard and that Thor had to cross the Dark Sea to reach him. Mirmir controlled the Mystic Fountain from which all waters flow. When Thor gave him a piece of the Tree of Life, Yggdrasill, Mirmir dipped it into the Fountain. Life flowed from it and dropped onto a pair of tree seeds that Odin had placed, which grew into the first humans, Aske and Embla.

mischa kepikoff.name: Mischa Kepikoff
mischa kepikoff.first_appearance: Kent Blake of the Secret Service Vol 1 1
mischa kepikoff.origin: Mischa Kepikoff was a secret service agent, who was assigned with the mission, to find out X-5's identity. His plan was to go to Russian restaurants, and tell some of the waiters that he loves his country, because X-5 was currently undercover as a Russian. One of the waiters, Serge Ospensko, then introduced him to Vasili Zaroff, X-5's identity. Vasili proceeded to ask him some questions, which Kepikoff answered with wrong informations. After X-5 left, one of the costumers, named Alexei, then gave him his adress. When Mischa arrived at X-5's house and tried to break the safe to get X-5's identity, Serge Ospensko appeared out of nowhere and tried to overpower him. That didn't worked, because Mischa stabbed him to death. Mischa returned to Washington, to meet his colleague Ivanoff. Mischa told him his story, and was near the end, when suddenly an unknwon person stabbed him in the back.

misery symbiote.name: Misery (Symbiote)
misery symbiote.species: A Symbiote created from the fusion of the Carnage and Anti-Venom symbiotes
misery symbiote.origin: Misery is a hybrid symbiote created as part of Alchemax's experiments weaponizing "strains" of the various symbiotes they had captured. Noting that the Carnage symbiote strain they had obtained refused to amalgamate with any of the others, Doctor Steven and Liz Allan exposed a sample of it bonded to a chimpanzee named Grace to Anti-Venom serum. When terminally-ill Guardsman Corwin Jones went AWOL, having been hired by the Life Foundation to steal all of Alchemax's symbiotes, Liz was exposed to a sample of the hybrid symbiote, which bonded to her. Grace, her symbiotes having stabilized into a copy of the Misery symbiote, attempted to kill Liz in an attempt to avenge the experiments performed on her, but was subdued and recaptured. After experimenting with her new powers, which included a greatly enhanced healing factor and the ability to liquify and reform her body, Liz confronted Corwin in his apartment only to discover he had bonded to all of the stolen symbiotes to create a single massive hybrid called Madness. Months after this crisis was solved, the Sleeper symbiote assumed the Onyx Throne following Hela's takeover of the Symbiote Hive-Mind and her subsequent defeat alongside Knull, with Misery joining his new Hive.

weapons: When bonded to a host, Misery possesses claws, fangs, and six bladed limbs protruding from its back. It can also transform its limbs into a variety of melee weapons.

mishka gudonov.name: Mishka Gudonov
mishka gudonov.origin: The Bear was a member of Red Dawn, who were a team of Russian elite parahuman commandos who were placed into suspended animation in a submarine off the coast of New York. The initial plan was for the soldiers to be activated in the event the Cold War turned into a real war, however, the submarine was left untouched until it was discovered in the year 2099. Alchemax uncovered the sub and Tyler Stone began the process of waking the Soviet agents. Miguel O'Hara was also brought along and uncovered the truth and so tried to stop the process, only releasing Chernobyl.

miss coriander.name: Miss Coriander
miss coriander.origin: Miss Coriander was hired to be the personal assistant to Arcade. Little is known about her past, but she appears to be trained in combat and engineering. At his request, Miss Coriander attacked Arcade on his birthday, and after catching him off guard she put him into intensive care. She was then fired and given Arcade's personal island near Barbados, which she renamed Coriander Island. left|thumb|200px Months later Arcade hired Miss Coriander again this time to help him design his new Murderworld. Miss Coriander oversaw the construction of Arcade's new Murderworld in Antarctica using cybernetics, hard light projections, force-fields, and nanite-rich oxygen. Additionally, she equipped Arcade with control over almost every aspect of the new Murderworld providing the illusion of superpowers. Despite Arcade attempting to murder her, Miss Coriander has continued to work with Arcade in the development of the Massacrer Casino in Bagalia. Miss Coriander later joins the Masters of Evil.

miss hazel.name: Miss Hazel
miss hazel.origin: Miss Hazel was a precognitive who lived and did hand reading at Crossroads, a shop / museum in the French Quarter of New Orleans. When the Strange Academy students ventured, Ms. Hazel tried to read Emily Bright's hand but she forcibly refused. To calm the waters, Doyle decided to have Ms. Hazel read the future form himself, but as soon as she touched him he had strong visions of a dark future. A few days later, Jericho Drumm went to find Ms. Hazel who was forced to wear a blindfold over her eyes as contact with Doyle had left her a part of himself that had bonded with her prophetic abilities so that she would continue seeing more than showing.

miss locke.name: Miss Locke
miss locke.origin: Miss Locke was a devout follower of Arcade and recruited the X-Men to save him when he was kidnapped by Doctor Doom. Once, as a birthday present, she tried to kill him using robots to the likeness of Doctor Doom, giving him a great thrill. Miss Locke was famous because she "never smiled". However, a glimpse of a smile could be seen when she was drugging the X-Men when accepting defeat during the birthday surprise, and again when hearing one of Murderworld's intended victims Courtney Ross telling a joke to survive. Miss Locke and Arcade frequently played games where they attempted to kill each other. Although intended as a sadistic form of fun, they eventually went too far and Arcade murdered Locke in a fit of rage. To hide his crime and use it for his amusement, Arcade staged a complex "Jack the Ripper"-like series of murders, hiding Miss Locke's body among the victims. He also arranged to blame Wolverine for the murders, and recruited Mastermind to help "punish" the mutant killer. The truth was eventually found out and Mastermind left Arcade in a telepathically-induced delusion. Miss Locke has since been seen alive, but whether her death was faked or if Arcade was merely using his lifelike robots to imitate his lost partner is unknown. Arcade would later confirm he did murder Miss Locke in cold blood despite her years of faithful service once she, in Arcade’s mind, had tried to get “too close” to him by having an emotional and physical relationship.

miss mech.species: Human with latent Inhuman lineage activated by the Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman HybridsCategory:Terrigen Bomb Activations; mech builder
miss mech.origin: Miss Mech is an aspiring super heroine, who spent most of her days Watching anime. Her favorite anime featured Kaiju/Mecha battle flicks, around the time when the Terrigen Cloud was dispersed over New York. While Kid Kaiju and Moongirl were at Central Park, Manhattan with their respective parents for a meet and greet between their respective Kaiju Compatriots. She went on the attack path using her NuHuman abilities to conjure giant robots to attack them with. Under the misguided pretense that giant monsters were often villains by any other name, with some quick thinking between Kei and Lunella, the two managed to corral their respective titans towards the mecha suit she was piloting. After Kei managed to talk her down, putting an end to all the mayhem, she admitted to her faults and relented. Having only wanted to be a hero like her idols Moongirl and Ms. Marvel, feeling a kindred spirit within her. Kei befriended Miss Mech opting to help her along the path of heroism like Ms. Lafayette and others had done for him.

Under the misguided pretense that giant monsters were often villains by any other name, with some quick thinking between Kei and Lunella, the two managed to corral their respective titans towards the mecha suit she was piloting. miss minutes.origin: Miss Minutes is an artificially intelligent holographic lifeform at the Time Variance Authority. Unlike all organic TVA employees, she was always aware of the true nature of the Time-Keepers, as her true loyalty was to He Who Remains, the true creator of the TVA. When Judge Ravonna Renslayer requested from Miss Minutes information pertaining to the creation of the TVA, Miss Minutes gave her completely different information instead. At the same time she appeared to Loki Variants L0852 and L1130 at the Citadel at the End of Time, where she gave them one last offer from He Who Remains to be reinserted into their preferred timeline should they agree to stop pursuing the truth behind the TVA.

mist mistress.name: Mist Mistress
mist mistress.origin: A former bookkeeper, Mist Mistress became a member of the Resistants when her mutant powers developed. She was a founding member of the group alongside the original Mutant Force members other than Slither. They gathered in direct opposition to the proposed Mutant Registration Act. With a group of other Resistants, Mist Mistress clashed with the then Captain America John Walker. Due to her nerves and lack of combat experience, Mist Mistress was easily beaten by Walker. Mist Mistress later demonstrated against the Act in Washington D.C. It has been confirmed that she was depowered as of M-Day and that her powers and others formed the Collective.

mister clean ucwf.name: Mister Clean (UCWF)
mister clean ucwf.origin: Mister Clean is a wrestler in the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation, the man known as Mister Clean was one of the many wrestlers who received enhanced strength from the Power Broker. Like all of the Power Broker's clients, Clean was hooked on drugs to force him to continue paying the Broker money. During his career he once had a practice spar with the Thing, who was the UCWF's reigning champion at the time. Later when the Power Broker sought to destroy Ms. Marvel for exposing his operations, Clean joined was among the many drug addled wrestlers who were sent to stop them; however, their fight with Ms. Marvel and the Thing abruptly ended when the Thing suddenly began mutating into a more monstrous form. Clean's subsequent activities are unknown.

mister dibbles.name: Mister Dibbles
mister dibbles.origin: During one of his adventures with the Avengers, Quicksilver became trapped in a state in which the rest of the world seemed motionless to him. While fighting a group of mysterious energy beings, Pietro stumbled into two kids that had a turtle on a paper bag and were preparing to smash it with a hammer. Pietro rescued the turtle, and decided to keep it for company, dubbing it "Mister Dibbles." He took it everywhere he went and talked to it despite the fact that the turtle was unmoving like the rest of the world. When Pietro's sister, the Scarlet Witch, managed to temporarily breach into the motionless dimension, she used her powers to unfreeze Mister Dibbles. The turtle's company helped Quicksilver sway away from insanity due to the isolation. When Pietro decided to take a final stand against the energy creatures, he left Mister Dibbles in a pond in Avengers Mansion for Jarvis to find it. When Pietro returned to the normal world, Jarvis reunited him with Mister Dibbles.

mister eleven.name: Mister Eleven
mister eleven.origin: Mister Eleven is a secretive individual who has ties to both Heaven and Hell and has been around since the time of the crucifixion, which triggered a quake known as "The Harrowing" that ravaged the Underworld. During the time that Lucifer had escaped Hell, Mister Eleven came across him and asked for him to arrange a meeting with Ghost Rider (Johnny Blaze). After he was decapitated by Lucifer, he inhabited a recently deceased corpse and set off after him. When he found the two locked in battle, Mister Eleven intervened to distract Lucifer and gain Ghost Rider's trust. He needed Ghost Rider's help to remember where he came from and who he was. Ghost Rider used his Penance Stare and revealed he was both a demon and an angel. The Penance Stare seemed to destroy, him but he was able to transfer his essence to a nearby bird. Staying in the form of the raven, he approached Danny Ketch and offered him increasingly greater doses of the Ghost Rider power. At this point, Mister Eleven was working on behalf of Zadkiel who asked Danny to destroy Verminus Rex who was killing other wielders of the Ghost Rider power to feed his own hunger. Ketch's friend and techno-witch, Mary LeBow, had researched that Mister Eleven, was likely working for the highest bidder during the siege on Heaven, and tried to convince Danny to stop transforming into Ghost Rider and trusting Mister Eleven. He ultimately killed her on Zadkiel's order but also aided her in finding a new body.

mister fantastic.species: Human mutated via exposure to cosmic rays
mister fantastic.origin: ===Early Childhood=== thumb|left|Reed Richards as a child Reed Nathaniel Richards was the only son of wealthy physicist Nathaniel Richards and his wife Evelyn. He was a child prodigy with special aptitude in mathematics, physics, and mechanics. As a child, Reed became close to his uncle Ted, Nathaniel's older brother who was an eccentric writer. However, this was during a period of political witch hunts for political dissidents. Ted was brought before a Senate commission, but Ted refused to speak about his activities or name those who might be involved in anti-government activities. This ruined Ted's entire life, and Nathaniel soon barred Ted from visiting Reed any more. This social and economic ruin drove Ted to suicide, and instilled in Reed a very strong sense that following the rule of law in America was important. thumb|Reed Richards as a young boy One of Reed's earliest childhood memories of his father was a day when his father told him to jump from a high place. Although Reed was scared his father taught him that it was okay to be afraid, but not trying something because of his fear was unacceptable. Reed also was a member of the boy scouts. Although Reed was popular in school, he knew that he was different from the other students. When he confided this in his father, Nathaniel told his son that he should embrace this and that someday there won't be anything that Reed will not be able to accomplish. One day while reading the fairy tale about Humpty Dumpty, Reed asked his parents how it could be possible to put the fictional character back together again. This started an educational discussion about "time's arrow". Although his parents told him that time runs in one direction, Reed began theorizing that it, in fact, ran both ways. By the time he was seven, Reed's mother had passed away. Reed's intelligence was at the college level by the time he was fourteen. ===Education=== Nathaniel encouraged and guided young Reed in his scientific studies, and Reed was taking college-level courses. Reed entered college at fourteen at Caltech (California Institute of Technology). He also attended Harvard University and M.I.T. He studied abroad at the University of Vienna in Austria. fields.personality: Reed is an intellectual who prefers to examine foes and if possible negotiate with them before actually fighting them. He is often intrigued by the scientific implications of a problem, so much so that he almost forgets there is a problem in the first place. As Ben once put it, "...if an alien stubbed his toe, Reed would want to spend ten years studying it." Reed is an extremely likable fellow who keeps a pleasant smile on his face and cares deeply about those he is close to, particularly his extended family. However, he does occasionally lapse into depression and self-hatred over long-standing unsolved problems, most notably Ben's inability to return to human form and Franklin's mysterious potential. Reed is a humanitarian who will try to prevent any intelligent being from suffering. This can lead him to do controversial things that fly in the face of all apparent logic, such as when he once saved Galactus from dying due to exhaustion from his hunger and attacking Earth. Susan once speculated that Reed's eccentric behavior may be due to autism.
transportation: formerly Avenger's Quinjet, Xantha (or Skrull) Saucer, Fantasti-Copter, U-Car (submarine), Fantasti-Car 1 (the "flying bathtub") (superseded), Marvel-1 (destroyed), and many others
fields.notes: The powers of all of the Fantastic Four are based on one of the four elements; in Neil Gaiman's , his power is associated with the classical element of water. The association to the element of water was also brought up in , X-Men/Fantastic Four, Ultimate Fantastic Four and in the Marvel Boy mini-series by Grant Morrison. Reed Richard is Agnostic and does not believe any human religion could be the one true religion. He well aware that Abstract Entities exist but would in no way worship them, considering them as highly evolved life forms, but also believes in a higher power that guides the universe, "Something bigger than us; something we can't totally comprehend". When asked by his son if he believed in God he answered "Yes I do Franklin. Because I believe religion and science go hand-in-hand". Reed has stated that the accident that gave him and the other members of the Fantastic Four their powers, as well as the fact that they survived the exposure and crash landing, led him to believe that there was "Something or someone bigger and more mysterious than us, who was watching us that day, protecting us". He cites the frequent resurrection of super heroes as "almost proof of a higher power, of someone who needs us to live to stop what's coming. To fight the good fight".
fields.trivia: Along with his penchant for inventing, Dr. Richards is often known to rewrite works of Stephen Hawking and decode alien languages. Reed allegedly won Nobel prizes. One of which was for the discovery of the Negative Zone. Category:Nobel Prizes Reed failed his driving test four times. *Based on the novel "Foundation" by Isaac Asimov, Reed put into practice one of the fictional concepts presented by said book, "Psychohistory:" the ability to use equations to predict future trends by mathematically modeling history. It was the first field ever created by Richards, and with it he can predict social trends to an extremely high degree of accuracy. Mr. Fantastic was one of the characters featured in Series A of the Marvel Value Stamps issued in the 1970s. thumb|right|Marvel Value Stamp #34

mister gor.name: Mister Gor
mister gor.origin: Mister Gor was the hunchbacked member of the Mad Squad, serving under its commander, Amanda von Doom. His past was marked by a traumatic relationship with his mother, who nearly killed him before a scientist rescued him. Gor eventually betrayed his benefactor, a history that Bruce Banner later used to torment him during the Mad Squad's confrontation with the scientist. Gor accompanied Amanda in recruiting the Hulk to help stop Banner, whose gamma experiments had produced an island full of monstrous creatures. During the mission, Gor fought Banner's creations and assisted Amanda in deploying B.R.A.I.N. against the scientist. Banner managed to incapacitate the engineered intelligence and reprogram it to attack Amanda, forcing her to destroy it to prevent further harm. Banner then taunted Gor about his past and reduced him to tears, but Amanda encouraged her colleague to regain his composure and refuse to let the scientist's psychological attacks defeat him. Gor continued to support Amanda during the operation, and both survived the gamma bomb explosion that killed Banner. They were subsequently confronted by the surviving gamma-mutates, who demanded that the island be restored in exchange for sparing the two humans. Gor's later activities included his continued association with Amanda and the Mad Squad as the team assisted the Hulk in pursuingDoctor Doom and fighting the Doombots responsible for further threats against him.

mister jip.name: Mister Jip
mister jip.origin: Mr. Jip was born in the 15th century somewhere in the Far East, under another name. At an early age, he left home seeking to acquire a vast amount of knowledge. He heard of an enlightened city called Kamar-Taj, somewhere in the Himalayas. When he finally reached the city, he found nothing but hulking ruins. Saddened by the lost chance to gain more knowledge, he sank down and cried. The last citizen of the city heard him, and thought he was weeping over the desolated occupants. The citizen, who would someday become the sorcerer supreme known as the Ancient One, took Jip on as his first student. Jip studied under the Ancient One for many years, until he was caught practicing a black rite. The Ancient One banished Jip, but allowed him to live. Jip continued his studies, but he was worried because he wouldn't live long enough to complete his quest for knowledge. He learned how to extend his lifespan by usurping the bodies of others. Unfortunately, he can only usurp the bodies of evil people, and his overuse of the body decays them at a rapid rate. He created the bizarre creature, Yipyap, to seek out evil people for him to usurp. Jip lived for many years in this manner, usurping body after body. In more recent years, Jip had created agents for him, called Night and Day. At one point, Yipyap found the hero known as Cloak and the darkness he contained. Jip planned to usurp Cloak's body, but Dagger had learned how to keep Cloak's darkness at bay with her light powers. Cloak feared that now he was normal, Dagger wouldn't express the same care she did when he was Cloak. Jip realized this and set up a curio shop in the neighborhood where Cloak and Dagger lived. Jip helped various people in the neighborhood, granting their hearts desires. Cloak now desperate, hears about the miracles the shop provided and enters. Jip, in the guise of a middle-aged shopkeeper, gave him a black cube in return for future services. A despondent Cloak eventually gave in to temptation and consumed the liquid that dripped from the black cube, turning him back into Cloak. Jip knew that Dagger would leave Cloak if he accepted his powers again. Dagger did leave at first, but she returned just in time to find Jip in the process of usurping Cloak's body. Dagger defended Cloak and defeated Jip's agents, Night and Day. The battle caused the being known as 'the Predator' to exit through Cloak, and attacked Day. The Predator scared Jip so bad that he fled. Later, Jip contacted Cloak, telling him that he was in his debt for giving him his powers back. He told Cloak to take Dagger to a certain spot and leave her, and then return to Jip. Cloak agreed, planning to trick Jip. Cloak teleported Dagger to what he thought was a safe spot. In actuality, when Jip attempted to usurp Cloak's body, Jip planted mental suggestions in Cloak's mind. These suggestions caused Cloak to leave Dagger at a spot where Night was waiting. When Cloak returned to Jip, Jip used a magic spell to stop him from going to rescue Dagger. Jip formed a scrying screen so that Cloak could watch helplessly while Night attacked Dagger. Jip then left Cloak alone to suffer while he went back to his studies. Cloak eventually escaped Jip's mystic bonds, thanks to the help of a child (Lamar Plotnick) and his father. Meanwhile, Night had caused Dagger to become evil. Luckily, the original mutant hero team X-Factor intervened, stopping Dagger and turning her back to normal. Night disappeared before she could be apprehended. Mr. Jip has vowed to gain his vengeance on Cloak and Dagger. Recently, Jip has gained control over Francis Delgado, a former priest who had become friends with Dagger. Delgado had at the time only recently been released from an mental asylum.

mister lightning.name: Mister Lightning
mister lightning.origin: Mister Lightning was a juggler in a traveling carnival. He amazed his audiences with his incredibly fast hands and skillful juggling ability. The pay of a carnival juggler, however, was not very much and Mister Lightning felt that his special talents were worth more money. An old man told him to stop wasting his time in the carnival because he could make a fortune with his quick reflexes as a quick-drawing gunslinger. Mister Lightning initially scoffed at this idea, having never before used a gun. The more he thought about it, however, the more it seemed that the old man had been right, so he bought a pair of Colts and practiced his quick draw in the mirror until he felt that he had it perfected. Mister Lightning then went out and challenged the fastest draw in town to a gunfight, and won, grazing the man in the arm. After this, Lightning went from town to town challenging gunmen to prove himself as the fastest around. Soon he had made a name for himself and was able to sell his services out as a hired gun, making a large sum of money in the process. He eventually became tired of hearing himself being described as the fastest draw in the west next to the Rawhide Kid, and decided to seek out the Kid and settle the matter once and for all. He found the Kid in Paso Flats, and challenged him to a draw. Mr. Lightning outdrew the Kid and shot him in the arm. Having proven himself to be the faster of the two men, Lightning left the Kid alone and went into town where he was celebrated as a hero for besting the Kid. All of this fame soon went to Lightning's head, as he now believed that there was no one capable of stopping him. He set out on a large crime spree in the weeks that followed, confident that no one would oppose him. The Rawhide Kid, however, heard that Lightning was terrorizing decent townspeople and sought him out. He found him in Red Gap and challenged him to another draw. Although Mr. Lightning outdrew him again, he was nervous because of the Kid's show of confidence and completely missed the Kid. As he fired his second shot, the Rawhide Kid fired his first and hit Mr. Lightning's bullet in midair. Frightened by the Kid's accuracy, Mr. Lightning surrendered, and promised him that he would never touch a gun again.
